{"parentUuid":"8458c27e-106c-4611-a4ba-8268b64c2ac2","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_hrgipzx8gm7x6hzq4ot6ym84","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp28/b/internal/engine/engine.go","content":"// Package engine wires nodes, the unreliable network and the discrete-event\n// scheduler into one deterministic simulation driven by a JSON Request.\npackage engine\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/node\"\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/sim\"\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/simnet\"\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/vec\"\n)\n\n// ---- Request model ------------------------------------------------------\n\n// BroadcastSpec schedules one broadcast at an absolute virtual time.\ntype BroadcastSpec struct {\n\tAtMs    int64  `json:\"at_ms\"`\n\tNode    string `json:\"node\"`\n\tPayload string `json:\"payload\"`\n}\n\n// TriggerSpec fires a broadcast when a node delivers AfterOrigin's message\n// (exact (node, seq) match). Used to generate causal broadcast chains.\ntype TriggerSpec struct {\n\tWhenNode    string `json:\"when_node\"`\n\tAfterOrigin vec.Key `json:\"after_origin\"`\n\tPayload     string `json:\"payload\"`\n}\n\n// RetransmitSpec asks node From (which retained FromOrigin's message) to emit\n// a fresh copy directly to each target in To, at AtMs. Direct injection is\n// required to repair an explicitly-faulted copy: explicit faults match by\n// (origin, from, to) and would otherwise drop the repair too.\ntype RetransmitSpec struct {\n\tAtMs       int64    `json:\"at_ms\"`\n\tFrom       string   `json:\"from\"`\n\tFromOrigin vec.Key  `json:\"from_origin\"`\n\tTo         []string `json:\"to\"`\n\tDelayMs    int64    `json:\"delay_ms\"`\n}\n\n// Request is the full JSON run interface.\ntype Request struct {\n\tSeed             int64                 `json:\"seed\"`\n\tNodes            []string              `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tEndTimeMs        int64                 `json:\"end_time_ms\"`\n\tBufferCapacity   int                   `json:\"buffer_capacity\"` // 0=default 16, -1=unbounded\n\tNetwork          simnet.Policy         `json:\"network\"`\n\tFaults           []simnet.Fault        `json:\"faults\"`\n\tBroadcasts       []BroadcastSpec       `json:\"broadcasts\"`\n\tTriggers         []TriggerSpec         `json:\"triggers\"`\n\tRetransmits      []RetransmitSpec      `json:\"retransmits\"`\n\tBackpressureRetry BackpressureRetryCfg `json:\"backpressure_retry\"`\n}\n\n// BackpressureRetryCfg controls automatic retry of rejected copies. With\n// MaxAttempts 0 (default) a rejected copy is permanently given up; -1 retries\n// without limit until it is accepted or simulation ends.\ntype BackpressureRetryCfg struct {\n\tDelayMs     int64 `json:\"delay_ms\"`\n\tMaxAttempts int   `json:\"max_attempts\"`\n}\n\n// ---- Response model -----------------------------------------------------\n\n// RetryEvent records the lifecycle of one backpressure retry.\ntype RetryEvent struct {\n\tTime     int64   `json:\"time\"`\n\tNode     string  `json:\"node\"`\n\tOrigin   vec.Key `json:\"origin\"`\n\tAttempt  int     `json:\"attempt\"`\n\tResult   string  `json:\"result\"` // canceled | delivered | buffered | backpressure | given_up\n}\n\n// RetransmitRecord logs one direct-injected repair copy.\ntype RetransmitRecord struct {\n\tTime   int64   `json:\"time\"`\n\tFrom   string  `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo     string  `json:\"to\"`\n\tOrigin vec.Key `json:\"origin\"`\n\tAtMs   int64   `json:\"arrival_at_ms\"`\n}\n\n// FinalReport summarizes the end-of-run state and permanent-loss diagnostics.\ntype FinalReport struct {\n\tEndTimeMs             int64                       `json:\"end_time_ms\"`\n\tBufferedPerNode       map[string][]vec.Key        `json:\"buffered_per_node\"`\n\tMissingForBuffered    map[string]map[string][]vec.Key `json:\"missing_for_buffered\"`\n\tRootMissingBlockers   []vec.Key                   `json:\"root_missing_blockers\"`\n\tUndeliveredOrigins    []vec.Key                   `json:\"undelivered_origins\"`\n\tDiagnostics           []string                    `json:\"diagnostics\"`\n}\n\n// Response is the JSON run result.\ntype Response struct {\n\tStatus          string                       `json:\"status\"` // ok | error\n\tError           string                       `json:\"error,omitempty\"`\n\tSeed            int64                        `json:\"seed\"`\n\tNodes           []string                     `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tDeliveries      []node.Delivery              `json:\"deliveries\"`\n\tDuplicates      map[string]int               `json:\"duplicates_suppressed_per_node\"`\n\tBackpressure    []node.BackpressureEvent     `json:\"backpressure_events\"`\n\tRetries         []RetryEvent                 `json:\"retry_events\"`\n\tNetworkDecisions []simnet.Decision           `json:\"network_decisions\"`\n\tRetransmits     []RetransmitRecord           `json:\"retransmits\"`\n\tFinal           *FinalReport                 `json:\"final_report\"`\n}\n\n// ---- Engine -------------------------------------------------------------\n\ntype engine struct {\n\treq   *Request\n\tsched *sim.Scheduler\n\trng   *rand.Rand\n\tnet   *simnet.SimnetLike\n\n\tnodes map[string]*node.Node\n\n\t// retained[node][origin] = message; populated for every node that\n\t// delivered a message, so retransmits can source it from any holder.\n\tretained map[string]map[vec.Key]*node.Message\n\n\t// per-origin broadcast sequence counters\n\tseq map[string]int\n\n\t// every origin that ever exists (for final diagnostics)\n\tallOrigins map[vec.Key]bool\n\n\t// response accumulators\n\tdeliveries  []node.Delivery\n\tbackpressure []node.BackpressureEvent\n\tretries     []RetryEvent\n\tretransmits []RetransmitRecord\n\n\t// trigger bookkeeping: index -> fired\n\ttriggerFired map[int]bool\n\t// active backpressure retries: node|origin -> attempts so far\n\tactiveRetry map[string]int\n}\n\n// validate checks the request and applies defaults.\nfunc validate(req *Request) error {\n\tif len(req.Nodes) < 2 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"at least 2 nodes required\")\n\t}\n\tseen := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, n := range req.Nodes {\n\t\tif n == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node id must not be empty\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tif seen[n] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"duplicate node id %q\", n)\n\t\t}\n\t\tseen[n] = true\n\t}\n\tif req.EndTimeMs <= 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"end_time_ms must be > 0\")\n\t}\n\tif req.BufferCapacity == 0 {\n\t\treq.BufferCapacity = 16\n\t}\n\tif req.BufferCapacity < -1 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"buffer_capacity must be -1 (unbounded), 0 (default) or positive\")\n\t}\n\tp := req.Network\n\tfor _, r := range []struct{ name string; v float64 }{\n\t\t{\"loss_rate\", p.LossRate}, {\"duplicate_rate\", p.DuplicateRate},\n\t} {\n\t\tif r.v < 0 || r.v > 1 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network.%s must be in [0,1]\", r.name)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif p.MinDelayMs < 0 || p.MaxDelayMs < 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network delays must be >= 0\")\n\t}\n\tif p.MaxDelayMs > 0 && p.MaxDelayMs < p.MinDelayMs {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network.max_delay_ms < min_delay_ms\")\n\t}\n\tknownNode := func(id, where string) error {\n\t\tif !seen[id] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%s references unknown node %q\", where, id)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tfor i, b := range req.Broadcasts {\n\t\tif err := knownNode(b.Node, fmt.Sprintf(\"broadcasts[%d]\", i)); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif b.AtMs < 0 || b.AtMs >= req.EndTimeMs {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"broadcasts[%d].at_ms outside [0, end_time_ms)\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor i, t := range req.Triggers {\n\t\tif err := knownNode(t.WhenNode, fmt.Sprintf(\"triggers[%d]\", i)); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := knownNode(t.AfterOrigin.Node, fmt.Sprintf(\"triggers[%d].after_origin\", i)); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif t.AfterOrigin.Seq <= 0 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"triggers[%d].after_origin.seq must be > 0\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor i, r := range req.Retransmits {\n\t\tif err := knownNode(r.From, fmt.Sprintf(\"retransmits[%d]\", i)); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := knownNode(r.FromOrigin.Node, fmt.Sprintf(\"retransmits[%d].from_origin\", i)); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.FromOrigin.Seq <= 0 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"retransmits[%d].from_origin.seq must be > 0\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.AtMs < 0 || r.AtMs >= req.EndTimeMs {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"retransmits[%d].at_ms outside [0, end_time_ms)\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor j, to := range r.To {\n\t\t\tif err := knownNode(to, fmt.Sprintf(\"retransmits[%d].to[%d]\", i, j)); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif to == r.From {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"retransmits[%d].to contains source node\", i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.DelayMs < 0 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"retransmits[%d].delay_ms must be >= 0\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tvalidAction := map[string]bool{\"deliver\": true, \"drop\": true, \"duplicate\": true, \"delay\": true, \"\": false}\n\tfor i, f := range req.Faults {\n\t\tif !validAction[f.Action] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"faults[%d] has invalid action %q\", i, f.Action)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif f.Action == \"delay\" && f.DelayMs < 0 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"faults[%d].delay_ms must be >= 0\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif req.BackpressureRetry.DelayMs < 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"backpressure_retry.delay_ms must be >= 0\")\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// Run validates and executes one simulation.\nfunc Run(req *Request) *Response {\n\tresp := &Response{Seed: req.Seed, Nodes: append([]string(nil), req.Nodes...)}\n\tif err := validate(req); err != nil {\n\t\tresp.Status = \"error\"\n\t\tresp.Error = err.Error()\n\t\treturn resp\n\t}\n\n\te := &engine{\n\t\treq:          req,\n\t\tsched:        sim.NewScheduler(),\n\t\trng:          rand.New(rand.NewSource(req.Seed)),\n\t\tnodes:        map[string]*node.Node{},\n\t\tretained:     map[string]map[vec.Key]*node.Message{},\n\t\tseq:          map[string]int{},\n\t\tallOrigins:   map[vec.Key]bool{},\n\t\ttriggerFired: map[int]bool{},\n\t\tactiveRetry:  map[string]int{},\n\t}\n\tcap := req.BufferCapacity\n\tfor _, id := range req.Nodes {\n\t\te.nodes[id] = node.New(id, cap)\n\t\te.retained[id] = map[vec.Key]*node.Message{}\n\t}\n\n\t// Network sink: schedule an arrival event for the copy.\n\tsink := func(at int64, to string, m *node.Message) {\n\t\tcp := *m\n\t\te.sched.At(at, \"arrive\", &arrivePayload{to: to, msg: &cp})\n\t}\n\te.net = simnet.NewNetwork(req.Network, req.Faults, e.rng, sink)\n\n\tfor i, b := range req.Broadcasts {\n\t\te.sched.At(b.AtMs, \"broadcast\", req.Broadcasts[i])\n\t}\n\tfor i, r := range req.Retransmits {\n\t\te.sched.At(r.AtMs, \"retransmit\", req.Retransmits[i])\n\t}\n\t// End sentinel scheduled last at endTime: all time < end events precede\n\t// it, same-time events inserted before it precede it (FIFO tie-break).\n\te.sched.At(req.EndTimeMs, \"end\", nil)\n\n\te.sched.Run(req.EndTimeMs, e.handle)\n\n\tresp.Status = \"ok\"\n\te.fillFinal(resp)\n\tresp.Deliveries = e.deliveries\n\tresp.Backpressure = e.backpressure\n\tresp.Retries = e.retries\n\tresp.Retransmits = e.retransmits\n\tresp.NetworkDecisions = e.net.Log()\n\tresp.Duplicates = map[string]int{}\n\tfor _, id := range req.Nodes {\n\t\tif d := e.nodes[id].DuplicateCount(); d > 0 {\n\t\t\tresp.Duplicates[id] = d\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn resp\n}\n\ntype arrivePayload struct {\n\tto         string\n\tmsg        *node.Message\n\tretryNode  string // non-empty when this is a backpressure retry\n\tretryKey   vec.Key\n\tattempt    int\n}\n\nfunc retryID(n string, k vec.Key) string { return n + \"|\" + k.String() }\n\nfunc (e *engine) handle(ev *sim.Event) {\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase \"broadcast\":\n\t\tb := ev.Data.(BroadcastSpec)\n\t\te.doBroadcast(ev.Time, b.Node, b.Payload)\n\tcase \"arrive\":\n\t\tp := ev.Data.(*arrivePayload)\n\t\te.onArrive(ev.Time, p)\n\tcase \"retransmit\":\n\t\tr := ev.Data.(RetransmitSpec)\n\t\te.onRetransmit(ev.Time, r)\n\tcase \"end\":\n\t\t// never fires (Run stops at t < endTime) but kept for clarity\n\t}\n}\n\n// doBroadcast creates a new message at fromNode, delivers it locally, stores\n// it for retransmits and floods one copy per other node via the network.\nfunc (e *engine) doBroadcast(now int64, fromNode, payload string) {\n\tnd := e.nodes[fromNode]\n\te.seq[fromNode]++\n\tseq := e.seq[fromNode]\n\tm := nd.Broadcast(seq, payload)\n\te.allOrigins[m.Origin] = true\n\te.retained[fromNode][m.Origin] = m\n\n\tout, delivered := nd.HandleLocal(now, m)\n\t_ = out\n\te.recordDeliveries(now, fromNode, delivered)\n\te.maybeTrigger(now, fromNode, delivered)\n\n\tfor _, to := range sortedOthers(e.req.Nodes, fromNode) {\n\t\tcp := *m\n\t\tcp.From = fromNode\n\t\te.net.Send(now, to, &cp)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (e *engine) onArrive(now int64, p *arrivePayload) {\n\t// Backpressure-retry bookkeeping: if the message made it in by another\n\t// path while waiting, the scheduled retry is a no-op.\n\tif p.retryNode != \"\" {\n\t\tid := retryID(p.retryNode, p.retryKey)\n\t\tif e.nodes[p.retryNode].Has(p.retryKey) {\n\t\t\te.retries = append(e.retries, RetryEvent{\n\t\t\t\tTime: now, Node: p.retryNode, Origin: p.retryKey,\n\t\t\t\tAttempt: p.attempt, Result: \"canceled\",\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\tdelete(e.activeRetry, id)\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\tnd := e.nodes[p.to]\n\toutcome, delivered, bp := nd.Handle(now, p.msg)\n\n\tswitch outcome {\n\tcase node.Duplicate:\n\t\t// nothing to log beyond per-node counter\n\t\tif p.retryNode != \"\" {\n\t\t\tdelete(e.activeRetry, retryID(p.retryNode, p.retryKey))\n\t\t}\n\tcase node.Buffered:\n\t\tif p.retryNode != \"\" {\n\t\t\te.retries = append(e.retries, RetryEvent{\n\t\t\t\tTime: now, Node: p.to, Origin: p.msg.Origin,\n\t\t\t\tAttempt: p.attempt, Result: \"buffered\",\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\tdelete(e.activeRetry, retryID(p.to, p.msg.Origin))\n\t\t}\n\tcase node.Delivered:\n\t\tif p.retryNode != \"\" {\n\t\t\te.retries = append(e.retries, RetryEvent{\n\t\t\t\tTime: now, Node: p.to, Origin: p.msg.Origin,\n\t\t\t\tAttempt: p.attempt, Result: \"delivered\",\n\t\t\t})\n\t\t\tdelete(e.activeRetry, retryID(p.to, p.msg.Origin))\n\t\t}\n\t\t// retain + flood so a recovered predecessor continues propagating\n\t\tfor _, dm := range delivered {\n\t\t\te.retained[p.to][dm.Origin] = dm\n\t\t}\n\t\te.recordDeliveries(now, p.to, delivered)\n\t\te.maybeTrigger(now, p.to, delivered)\n\t\tfor _, dm := range delivered {\n\t\t\te.relay(now, p.to, := range e.allOrigins {\n\t\tif expected[k.Node] < k.Seq {\n\t\t\texpected[k.Node] = k.Seq\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// Per-node buffered state and its missing dependencies.\n\tfor _, id := range e.req.Nodes %s\", id, strings.Join(parts, \"; \")))\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif len(diags) == 0 {\n\t\tdiags = append(diags, \"all broadcasts delivered to all nodes in causal order\")\n\t}\n\tfin.Diagnostics = Package engine wires nodes, the unreliable network and the discrete-event\n// scheduler into one deterministic simulation driven by a JSON Request.\npackage engine\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\t\"strings\"\n\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/node\"\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/sim\"\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/simnet\"\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/vec\"\n)\n\n// ---- Request model ------------------------------------------------------\n\n// BroadcastSpec schedules one broadcast at an absolute virtual time.\ntype BroadcastSpec struct {\n\tAtMs    int64  `json:\"at_ms\"`\n\tNode    string `json:\"node\"`\n\tPayload string `json:\"payload\"`\n}\n\n// TriggerSpec fires a broadcast when a node delivers AfterOrigin's message\n// (exact (node, seq) match). Used to generate causal broadcast chains.\ntype TriggerSpec struct {\n\tWhenNode    string `json:\"when_node\"`\n\tAfterOrigin vec.Key `json:\"after_origin\"`\n\tPayload     string `json:\"payload\"`\n}\n\n// RetransmitSpec asks node From (which retained FromOrigin's message) to emit\n// a fresh copy directly to each target in To, at AtMs. Direct injection is\n// required to repair an explicitly-faulted copy: explicit faults match by\n// (origin, from, to) and would otherwise drop the repair too.\ntype RetransmitSpec struct {\n\tAtMs       int64    `json:\"at_ms\"`\n\tFrom       string   `json:\"from\"`\n\tFromOrigin vec.Key  `json:\"from_origin\"`\n\tTo         []string `json:\"to\"`\n\tDelayMs    int64    `json:\"delay_ms\"`\n}\n\n// Request is the full JSON run interface.\ntype Request struct {\n\tSeed             int64                 `json:\"seed\"`\n\tNodes            []string              `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tEndTimeMs        int64                 `json:\"end_time_ms\"`\n\tBufferCapacity   int                   `json:\"buffer_capacity\"` // 0=default 16, -1=unbounded\n\tNetwork          simnet.Policy         `json:\"network\"`\n\tFaults           []simnet.Fault        `json:\"faults\"`\n\tBroadcasts       []BroadcastSpec       `json:\"broadcasts\"`\n\tTriggers         []TriggerSpec         `json:\"triggers\"`\n\tRetransmits      []RetransmitSpec      `json:\"retransmits\"`\n\tBackpressureRetry BackpressureRetryCfg `json:\"backpressure_retry\"`\n}\n\n// BackpressureRetryCfg controls automatic retry of rejected copies. With\n// MaxAttempts 0 (default) a rejected copy is permanently given up; -1 retries\n// without limit until it is accepted or simulation ends.\ntype BackpressureRetryCfg struct {\n\tDelayMs     int64 `json:\"delay_ms\"`\n\tMaxAttempts int   `json:\"max_attempts\"`\n}\n\n// ---- Response model -----------------------------------------------------\n\n// RetryEvent records the lifecycle of one backpressure retry.\ntype RetryEvent struct {\n\tTime     int64   `json:\"time\"`\n\tNode     string  `json:\"node\"`\n\tOrigin   vec.Key `json:\"origin\"`\n\tAttempt  int     `json:\"attempt\"`\n\tResult   string  `json:\"result\"` // canceled | delivered | buffered | backpressure | given_up\n}\n\n// RetransmitRecord logs one direct-injected repair copy.\ntype RetransmitRecord struct {\n\tTime   int64   `json:\"time\"`\n\tFrom   string  `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo     string  `json:\"to\"`\n\tOrigin vec.Key `json:\"origin\"`\n\tAtMs   int64   `json:\"arrival_at_ms\"`\n}\n\n// FinalReport summarizes the end-of-run state and permanent-loss diagnostics.\ntype FinalReport struct {\n\tEndTimeMs             int64                       `json:\"end_time_ms\"`\n\tBufferedPerNode       map[string][]vec.Key        `json:\"buffered_per_node\"`\n\tMissingForBuffered    map[string]map[string][]vec.Key `json:\"missing_for_buffered\"`\n\tRootMissingBlockers   []vec.Key                   `json:\"root_missing_blockers\"`\n\tUndeliveredOrigins    []vec.Key                   `json:\"undelivered_origins\"`\n\tDiagnostics           []string                    `json:\"diagnostics\"`\n}\n\n// Response is the JSON run result.\ntype Response struct {\n\tStatus          string                       `json:\"status\"` // ok | error\n\tError           string                       `json:\"error,omitempty\"`\n\tSeed            int64                        `json:\"seed\"`\n\tNodes           []string                     `json:\"nodes\"`\n\tDeliveries      []node.Delivery              `json:\"deliveries\"`\n\tDuplicates      map[string]int               `json:\"duplicates_suppressed_per_node\"`\n\tBackpressure    []node.BackpressureEvent     `json:\"backpressure_events\"`\n\tRetries         []RetryEvent                 `json:\"retry_events\"`\n\tNetworkDecisions []simnet.Decision           `json:\"network_decisions\"`\n\tRetransmits     []RetransmitRecord           `json:\"retransmits\"`\n\tFinal           *FinalReport                 `json:\"final_report\"`\n}\n\n// ---- Engine -------------------------------------------------------------\n\ntype engine struct {\n\treq   *Request\n\tsched *sim.Scheduler\n\trng   *rand.Rand\n\tnet   *simnet.SimnetLike\n\n\tnodes map[string]*node.Node\n\n\t// retained[node][origin] = message; populated for every node that\n\t// delivered a message, so retransmits can source it from any holder.\n\tretained map[string]map[vec.Key]*node.Message\n\n\t// per-origin broadcast sequence counters\n\tseq map[string]int\n\n\t// every origin that ever exists (for final diagnostics)\n\tallOrigins map[vec.Key]bool\n\n\t// response accumulators\n\tdeliveries  []node.Delivery\n\tbackpressure []node.BackpressureEvent\n\tretries     []RetryEvent\n\tretransmits []RetransmitRecord\n\n\t// trigger bookkeeping: index -> fired\n\ttriggerFired map[int]bool\n\t// active backpressure retries: node|origin -> attempts so far\n\tactiveRetry map[string]int\n}\n\n// validate checks the request and applies defaults.\nfunc validate(req *Request) error {\n\tif len(req.Nodes) < 2 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"at least 2 nodes required\")\n\t}\n\tseen := map[string]bool{}\n\tfor _, n := range req.Nodes {\n\t\tif n == \"\" {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node id must not be empty\")\n\t\t}\n\t\tif seen[n] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"duplicate node id %q\", n)\n\t\t}\n\t\tseen[n] = true\n\t}\n\tif req.EndTimeMs <= 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"end_time_ms must be > 0\")\n\t}\n\tif req.BufferCapacity == 0 {\n\t\treq.BufferCapacity = 16\n\t}\n\tif req.BufferCapacity < -1 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"buffer_capacity must be -1 (unbounded), 0 (default) or positive\")\n\t}\n\tp := req.Network\n\tfor _, r := range []struct{ name string; v float64 }{\n\t\t{\"loss_rate\", p.LossRate}, {\"duplicate_rate\", p.DuplicateRate},\n\t} {\n\t\tif r.v < 0 || r.v > 1 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network.%s must be in [0,1]\", r.name)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif p.MinDelayMs < 0 || p.MaxDelayMs < 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network delays must be >= 0\")\n\t}\n\tif p.MaxDelayMs > 0 && p.MaxDelayMs < p.MinDelayMs {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network.max_delay_ms < min_delay_ms\")\n\t}\n\tknownNode := func(id, where string) error {\n\t\tif !seen[id] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"%s references unknown node %q\", where, id)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tfor i, b := range req.Broadcasts {\n\t\tif err := knownNode(b.Node, fmt.Sprintf(\"broadcasts[%d]\", i)); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif b.AtMs < 0 || b.AtMs >= req.EndTimeMs {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"broadcasts[%d].at_ms outside [0, end_time_ms)\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor i, t := range req.Triggers {\n\t\tif err := knownNode(t.WhenNode, err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif t.AfterOrigin.Seq <= 0 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"triggers[%d].after_origin.seq must be > 0\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor i, r := range req.Retransmits {\n\t\tif err := knownNode(r.From, fmt.Sprintf(\"retransmits[%d]\", i)); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif err := knownNode(r.FromOrigin.Node, fmt.Sprintf(\"retransmits[%d].from_origin\", i)); err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.FromOrigin.Seq <= 0 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"retransmits[%d].from_origin.seq must be > 0\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.AtMs < 0 || r.AtMs >= req.EndTimeMs {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"retransmits[%d].at_ms outside [0, end_time_ms)\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor j, to := range r.To {\n\t\t\tif err := knownNode(to, fmt.Sprintf(\"retransmits[%d].to[%d]\", i, j)); err != nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn err\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif to == r.From {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"retransmits[%d].to contains source node\", i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif r.DelayMs < 0 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"retransmits[%d].delay_ms must be >= 0\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tvalidAction := map[string]bool{\"deliver\": true, \"drop\": true, \"duplicate\": true, \"delay\": true, \"\": false}\n\tfor i, f := range req.Faults {\n\t\tif !validAction[f.Action] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"faults[%d] has invalid action %q\", i, f.Action)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif f.Action == \"delay\" && f.DelayMs < 0 {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"faults[%d].delay_ms must be >= 0\", i)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif req.BackpressureRetry.DelayMs < 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"backpressure_retry.delay_ms must be >= 0\")\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\n// Run validates and executes one simulation.\nfunc Run(req *Request) *Response {\n\tresp := &Response{Seed: req.Seed, Nodes: append([]string(nil), req.Nodes...)}\n\tif err := validate(req); err != nil {\n\t\tresp.Status = \"error\"\n\t\tresp.Error = err.Error()\n\t\treturn resp\n\t}\n\n\te := &engine{\n\t\treq:          req,\n\t\tsched:        sim.NewScheduler(),\n\t\trng:          rand.New(rand.NewSource(req.Seed)),\n\t\tnodes:        map[string]*node.Node{},\n\t\tretained:     map[string]map[vec.Key]*node.Message{},\n\t\tseq:          map[string]int{},\n\t\tallOrigins:   map[vec.Key]bool{},\n\t\ttriggerFired: map[int]bool{},\n\t\tactiveRetry:  map[string]int{},\n\t}\n\tcap := req.BufferCapacity\n\tfor _, id := range req.Nodes {\n\t\te.nodes[id] = node.New(id, cap)\n\t\te.retained[id] = map[vec.Key]*node.Message{}\n\t}\n\n\t// Network sink: schedule an arrival event for the copy.\n\tsink := func(at int64, to string, m *node.Message) {\n\t\tcp := *m\n\t\te.sched.At(at, \"arrive\", &arrivePayload{to: to, msg: &cp})\n\t}\n\te.net = simnet.NewNetwork(req.Network, req.Faults, e.rng, sink)\n\n\tfor i, b := range req.Broadcasts {\n\t\te.sched.At(b.AtMs, \"broadcast\", req.Broadcasts[i])\n\t}\n\tfor i, r := range req.Retransmits {\n\t\te.sched.At(r.AtMs, \"retransmit\", req.Retransmits[i])\n\t}\n\t// End sentinel scheduled last at endTime: all time < end events precede\n\t// it, same-time events inserted before it precede it (FIFO tie-break).\n\te.sched.At(req.EndTimeMs, \"end\", nil)\n\n\te.sched.Run(req.EndTimeMs, e.handle)\n\n\tresp.Status = \"ok\"\n\te.fillFinal(resp)\n\tresp.Deliveries = e.deliveries\n\tresp.Backpressure = e.backpressure\n\tresp.Retries = e.retries\n\tresp.Retransmits = e.retransmits\n\tresp.NetworkDecisions = e.net.Log()\n\tresp.Duplicates = map[string]int{}\n\tfor _, id := range req.Nodes {\n\t\tif d := e.nodes[id].DuplicateCount(); d > 0 {\n\t\t\tresp.Duplicates[id] = d\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn resp\n}\n\ntype arrivePayload struct {\n\tto         string\n\tmsg        *node.Message\n\tretryNode  string // non-empty when this is a backpressure retry\n\tretryKey   vec.Key\n\tattempt    int\n}\n\nfunc retryID(n string, k vec.Key) string { return n + \"|\" + k.String() }\n\nfunc (e *engine) handle(ev *sim.Event) {\n\tswitch ev.Kind {\n\tcase \"broadcast\":\n\t\tb := ev.Data.(BroadcastSpec)\n\t\te.doBroadcast(ev.Time, b.Node, b.Payload)\n\tcase \"arrive\":\n\t\tp := ev.Data.(*arrivePayload)\n\t\te.onArrive(ev.Time, doBroadcast creates a new message at fromNode, delivers it locally, stores\n// it for retransmits and floods one copy per other node via the network.\nfunc (e *engine) doBroadcast(now int64, fromNode, dependencies are\n// not yet satisfied, de-duplication and bounded-buffer backpressure.\npackage node\n\nimport (\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/vec\"\n)\n\n// Message is one vec.Clock `json:\"clock_after\"`\n}\n\n// Outcome classifies what a node does with an incoming copy.\ntype Outcome int\n\nconst (\n\t// Delivered means this copy (or buffered messages it unblocked) dropped.\n\tDuplicate\n\t// Backpressure means dependencies are missing AND the buffer is full;\n\t// the message is rejected and NOT retained (retry may arrive later).\n\tBackpressure\n)\n\n// BackpressureEvent captures one rejected copy for diagnostics.\ntype BackpressureEvent struct {\n\tTime      int64     `json:\"time\"`\n\tNode      string    `json:\"node\"`\n\tOrigin    vec.Key   `json:\"origin\"`\n\tCapacity  int       `json:\"capacity\"`\n\tWaitingOn []vec.Key `json:\"waiting_on\"`\n}\n\n// Node is a single simulated process.\ntype Node struct {\n\tID       string\n\tclock    vec.Clock\n\tbuffer   map[vec.Key]*Message\n\tdelivered map[vec.Key]bool\n\tcap      int\n\n\t// Counters/logs\n\tdupCount       int\n\tbackpressure   []BackpressureEvent\n}\n\n// New creates a node with a hold-back buffer bounded by capacity (<=0 means\n// unbounded).\nfunc New(id string, capacity int) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tID:        id,\n\t\tclock:     vec.Clock{},\n\t\tbuffer:    map[vec.Key]*Message{},\n\t\tdelivered: map[vec.Key]bool{},\n\t\tcap:       capacity,\n\t}\n}\n\n// Clock returns a copy of the node's delivered vector clock.\nfunc (n *Node) Clock() vec.Clock { return n.clock.Clone() }\n\n// BufferLen returns the number of messages currently held back.\nfunc (n *Node) BufferLen() int { return len(n.buffer) }\n\n// BufferKeys returns the origins currently buffered, deterministically sorted.\nfunc (n *Node) BufferKeys() []vec.Key {\n\tout := make([]vec.Key, 0, len(n.buffer))\n\tfor k := range n.buffer {\n\t\tout = append(out, k)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Less(out[j]) })\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// BufferedMissing returns, for every buffered message, the dependencies still\n// missing at this node, keyed by the buffered message origin.\nfunc (n *Node) BufferedMissing() map[string][]vec.Key {\n\tout := map[string][]vec.Key{}\n\tfor _, k := range n.BufferKeys() {\n\t\tm := n.buffer[k]\n\t\tmiss := vec.MissingDeps(n.clock, m.Deps)\n\t\tif len(miss) > 0 {\n\t\t\tout[k.String()] = miss\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// DuplicateCount returns how many duplicate copies were suppressed.\nfunc (n *Node) DuplicateCount() int { return n.dupCount }\n\n// BackpressureEvents returns the log of rejected copies.\nfunc (n *Node) BackpressureEvents() []BackpressureEvent { return n.backpressure }\n\n// Broadcast constructs a new message originating at this node. seq is the\n// node's next per-origin sequence number and is supplied by the engine.\nfunc (n *Node) Broadcast(seq int, payload string) *Message {\n\tk := vec.Key{Node: n.ID, Seq: seq}\n\tdeps := n.clock.Deps()\n\t// A message causally depends on itself as well for receiver bookkeeping;\n\t// the origin key is added explicitly (own clock does not contain it yet).\n\tdeps = append(deps, k)\n\tsort.Slice(deps, func(i, j int) bool { return deps[i].Less(deps[j]) })\n\tclock := n.clock.Clone()\n\tclock.Observe(k)\n\treturn &Message{\n\t\tOrigin:  k,\n\t\tSender:  n.ID,\n\t\tFrom:    n.ID,\n\t\tDeps:    deps,\n\t\tClock:   clock,\n\t\tPayload: payload,\n\t}\n}\n\n// Handle processes one incoming copy at virtual time t. It returns the\n// outcome, zero or more newly delivered messages (the incoming one first,\n// then any buffered messages released by it, in causal-safe order), and a\n// backpressure record when the outcome is Backpressure.\nfunc (n *Node) Handle(t int64, m *Message) (Outcome, []*Message, *BackpressureEvent) {\n\t// 1. De-duplication: delivered origins are accepted at most once; a copy\n\t// already sitting in the buffer is also a duplicate.\n\tif n.delivered[m.Origin] || n.buffer[m.Origin] != nil {\n\t\tn.dupCount++\n\t\treturn Duplicate, nil, nil\n\t}\n\n\t// 2. Causal readiness check against the delivered vector clock.\n\tmiss := vec.MissingDeps(n.clock, m.Deps)\n\tif len(miss) == 0 {\n\t\tdelivered := n.deliver(m)\n\t\tdelivered = append(delivered, n.flush()...)\n\t\treturn Delivered, delivered, nil\n\t}\n\n\t// 3. Not ready: buffer, or reject with backpressure if the bounded\n\t// buffer is full. Rejection never mutates clock or buffer, so causal\n\t// order cannot be violated by a later retry.\n\tif n.cap > 0 && len(n.buffer) >= n.cap {\n\t\tbp := &BackpressureEvent{\n\t\t\tTime:      t,\n\t\t\tNode:      n.ID,\n\t\t\tOrigin:    m.Origin,\n\t\t\tCapacity:  n.cap,\n\t\t\tWaitingOn: miss,\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.backpressure = append(n.backpressure, *bp)\n\t\treturn Backpressure, nil, bp\n\t}\n\n\tcp := *m\n\tn.buffer[m.Origin] = &cp\n\treturn Buffered, nil, nil\n}\n\n// deliver applies one ready message: observe it and return it.\nfunc (n *Node) deliver(m *Message) []*Message {\n\tn.clock.Observe(m.Origin)\n\tn.delivered[m.Origin] = true\n\treturn []*Message{m}\n}\n\n// flush repeatedly scans the buffer and delivers every message whose\n// dependencies are now satisfied, until a scan delivers nothing. Within a\n// scan the deterministic key order makes releases reproducible.\nfunc (n *Node) flush() []*Message {\n\tvar out []*Message\n\tfor {\n\t\tvar ready []vec.Key\n\t\tfor _, k := range n.BufferKeys() {\n\t\t\tif len(vec.MissingDeps(n.clock, n.buffer[k].Deps)) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\tready = append(ready, k)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif len(ready) == 0 {\n\t\t\treturn out\n\t\t}\n\t\tfor _, k := range ready {\n\t\t\tm := n.buffer[k]\n\t\t\tdelete(n.buffer, k)\n\t\t\tout = append(out, n.deliver(m)...)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// DeliveriesCount reports how many distinct messages have been delivered.\nfunc (n *Node) DeliveriesCount() int { return len(n.delivered) }\n\n// Has reports whether the node already delivered or currently buffers k.\n// Used to suppress a backpressure-retry whose message arrived by another path.\nfunc (n *Node) Has(k vec.Key) bool {\n\treturn n.delivered[k] || n.buffer[k] != nil\n}\n\n// String aids debugging in test failures.\nfunc (n *Node) String() string {\n\treturn fmt.Sprintf(\"Node(%s, clock=%v, buffered=%d)\", n.ID, map[string]int(n.clock), len(n.buffer))\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":175,"oldLines":6,"newStart":175,"newLines":18,"lines":["   return Buffered, nil, nil"," }"," ","+// HandleLocal delivers a message originated at this node. map[vec.Key]*Message{},\n\t\tdelivered: map[vec.Key]bool{},\n\t\tcap:       capacity,\n\t}\n}\n\n// Clock returns a copy of the node's delivered vector clock.\nfunc (n *Node) Clock() vec.Clock { Loss,\n// duplication and reordering therefore arise naturally from per-copy delays\n// rather than from any real cluster or wall-clock timing.\npackage simnet\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/node\"\n)\n\n// Action describes what the network did with one copy.\ntype Action string\n\nconst (\n\tActionDelivered Action = \"delivered\" // one copy scheduled\n\tActionDuplicate Action = \"duplicate\" // two copies scheduled (independent arrival paths)\n\tActionDropped   Action = \"dropped\"   // copy discarded\n)\n\n// Policy is the seeded stochastic part of the network. Rates are in [0,1].\ntype Policy struct {\n\tLossRate     float64 `json:\"loss_rate\"`\n\tDuplicateRate float64 `json:\"duplicate_rate\"`\n\tMinDelayMs   int64   `json:\"min_delay_ms\"`\n\tMaxDelayMs   int64   `json:\"max_delay_ms\"`\n}\n\n// Fault is an explicit, deterministic override matching individual copies.\n// Empty string / 0 in a matcher means wildcard; -1 in DelayMs means\n// \"no override\". First matching fault wins; stochastic policy is only\n// consulted when no fault matches.\ntype Fault struct {\n\tOriginNode string `json:\"origin_node,omitempty\"`\n\tOriginSeq  int    `json:\"origin_seq,omitempty\"`\n\tFrom       string `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n\tTo         string `json:\"to,omitempty\"`\n\tAction     string `json:\"action\"`               // deliver | drop | duplicate | delay\n\tDelayMs    int64  `json:\"delay_ms,omitempty\"`  // for action=delay\n}\n\n// Decision is the logged outcome of one Send call.\ntype Decision struct {\n\tTime     int64  `json:\"time\"`\n\tFrom     string `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo       string `json:\"to\"`\n\tOrigin   string `json:\"origin\"`\n\tAction   Action `json:\"action\"`\n\tDelayMs  int64  `json:\"delay_ms,omitempty\"`\n\tReason   string `json:\"reason\"` // \"fault\" or \"random\"\n}\n\n// Sink receives scheduled arrivals. The engine supplies it so the network\n// stays free of simulator/event-package imports.\ntype Sink func(arrivalTime int64, to string, m *node.Message)\n\n// Network applies faults + random policy and schedules copies via Sink.\ntype Network struct {\n\tpolicy Policy\n\tfaults []Fault\n\trng    *rand.Rand\n\tsink   Sink\n\tlog    []Decision\n}\n\n// New builds a network. rng is shared and advanced deterministically (one\n// draw block per Send, nodes traversed in sorted order by the engine).\nfunc New(policy Policy, faults []Fault, rng *rand.Rand, sink Sink) *Network {\n\treturn &Network{policy: policy, faults: faults, rng: rng, sink: sink}\n}\n\n// Log returns all per-copy decisions in send order.\nfunc (n *Network) Log() []Decision { return n.log }\n\nfunc (n *Network) match(m *node.Message, to string) (*Fault, bool) {\n\tfor i := range n.faults {\n\t\tf := &n.faults[i]\n\t\tif f.OriginNode != \"\" && f.OriginNode != m.Origin.Node {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif f.OriginSeq != 0 && f.OriginSeq != m.Origin.Seq {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif f.From != \"\" && f.From != m.From {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif f.To != \"\" && f.To != to {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn f, true\n\t}\n\treturn nil, false\n}\n\nfunc (n *Network) delay() int64 {\n\tlo, hi := n.policy.MinDelayMs, n.policy.MaxDelayMs\n\tif hi < lo {\n\t\thi = lo\n\t}\n\tif hi <= 0 {\n\t\treturn 0\n\t}\n\treturn lo + n.rng.Int63n(hi-lo+1)\n}\n\n// Send handles one copy from m.From to to at virtual time now. It records a\n// Decision and, unless dropped, schedules one (or two) arrivals through Sink.\nfunc (n *Network) Send(now int64, to string, m *node.Message) {\n\tarrival := func(d int64) {\n\t\tn.sink(now+d, to, m)\n\t}\n\tdecision := Decision{\n\t\tTime:   now,\n\t\tFrom:   m.From,\n\t\tTo:     to,\n\t\tOrigin: m.Origin.String(),\n\t}\n\n\tif f, ok := n.match(m, to); ok {\n\t\tdecision.Reason = \"fault\"\n\t\tswitch Action(f.Action) {\n\t\tcase ActionDropped:\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDropped\n\t\tcase ActionDuplicate:\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDuplicate\n\t\t\td := f.DelayMs\n\t\t\tif d < 0 {\n\t\t\t\td = n.delay()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tdecision.DelayMs = d\n\t\t\tarrival(d)\n\t\t\tarrival(d + 1) // distinct arrival times, still a true duplicate copy\n\t\tcase \"delay\":\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDelivered\n\t\t\tdecision.DelayMs = f.DelayMs\n\t\t\tarrival(f.DelayMs)\n\t\tdefault: // \"delivered\"\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDelivered\n\t\t\td := f.DelayMs\n\t\t\tif d < 0 {\n\t\t\t\td = n.delay()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tdecision.DelayMs = d\n\t\t\tarrival(d)\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.log = append(n.log, decision)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Stochastic policy: fixed draw order per copy -> reproducible.\n\tdecision.Reason = \"random\"\n\tif r := n.rng.Float64(); (file state is current in your context — no need to Read it back)"}]},"uuid":"0c08b864-42a2-4f30-bfcb-fa196934f848","timestamp":"2026-09-23T05:06:15.193Z","toolUseResult":{"filePath":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp28/b/internal/simnet/network.go","oldString":"\t\tcase ActionDropped:\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDropped\n\t\tcase ActionDuplicate:\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDuplicate","newString":"\t\tcase \"drop\":\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDropped\n\t\tcase \"duplicate\":","originalFile":"// Package simnet models an unreliable in-process network: every message copy\n// sent between two nodes may be dropped, duplicated and/or delayed. Loss,\n// duplication and reordering therefore arise naturally from per-copy delays\n// rather than from any real cluster or wall-clock timing.\npackage simnet\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/node\"\n)\n\n// Action describes what the network did with one copy.\ntype Action string\n\nconst (\n\tActionDelivered Action = \"delivered\" // one copy scheduled\n\tActionDuplicate Action = \"duplicate\" // two copies scheduled (independent arrival paths)\n\tActionDropped   Action = \"dropped\"   // copy discarded\n)\n\n// Policy is the seeded stochastic part of the network. Rates are in [0,1].\ntype Policy struct {\n\tLossRate     float64 `json:\"loss_rate\"`\n\tDuplicateRate float64 `json:\"duplicate_rate\"`\n\tMinDelayMs   int64   `json:\"min_delay_ms\"`\n\tMaxDelayMs   int64   `json:\"max_delay_ms\"`\n}\n\n// Fault is an explicit, deterministic override matching individual copies.\n// Empty string / 0 in a matcher means wildcard; -1 in DelayMs means\n// \"no override\". First matching fault wins; stochastic policy is only\n// consulted when no fault matches.\ntype Fault struct {\n\tOriginNode string `json:\"origin_node,omitempty\"`\n\tOriginSeq  int    `json:\"origin_seq,omitempty\"`\n\tFrom       string `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n\tTo         string `json:\"to,omitempty\"`\n\tAction     string `json:\"action\"`               // deliver | drop | duplicate | delay\n\tDelayMs    int64  `json:\"delay_ms,omitempty\"`  // for action=delay\n}\n\n// Decision is the logged outcome of one Send call.\ntype Decision struct {\n\tTime     int64  `json:\"time\"`\n\tFrom     string `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo       string `json:\"to\"`\n\tOrigin   string `json:\"origin\"`\n\tAction   Action `json:\"action\"`\n\tDelayMs  int64  `json:\"delay_ms,omitempty\"`\n\tReason   string `json:\"reason\"` // \"fault\" or \"random\"\n}\n\n// Sink receives scheduled arrivals. The engine supplies it so the network\n// stays free of simulator/event-package imports.\ntype Sink func(arrivalTime int64, to string, m *node.Message)\n\n// Network applies faults + random policy and schedules copies via Sink.\ntype Network struct {\n\tpolicy Policy\n\tfaults []Fault\n\trng    *rand.Rand\n\tsink   Sink\n\tlog    []Decision\n}\n\n// New builds a network. rng is shared and advanced deterministically (one\n// draw block per Send, nodes traversed in sorted order by the engine).\nfunc New(policy Policy, faults []Fault, rng *rand.Rand, sink Sink) *Network {\n\treturn &Network{policy: policy, faults: faults, rng: rng, sink: sink}\n}\n\n// Log returns all per-copy decisions in send order.\nfunc (n *Network) Log() []Decision { return n.log }\n\nfunc (n *Network) match(m *node.Message, to string) (*Fault, bool) {\n\tfor i := range n.faults {\n\t\tf := &n.faults[i]\n\t\tif f.OriginNode != \"\" && f.OriginNode != m.Origin.Node {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif f.OriginSeq != 0 && f.OriginSeq != m.Origin.Seq {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// An omitted From anchors the fault to the FIRST hop: it matches\n\t\t// only copies sent by the message originator. Set From explicitly\n\t\t// to target relay (gossip) copies from another holder.\n\t\tfrom := f.From\n\t\tif from == \"\" {\n\t\t\tfrom = m.Origin.Node\n\t\t}\n\t\tif from != m.From {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif f.To != \"\" && f.To != to {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn f, true\n\t}\n\treturn nil, false\n}\n\nfunc (n *Network) delay() int64 {\n\tlo, hi := n.policy.MinDelayMs, n.policy.MaxDelayMs\n\tif hi < lo {\n\t\thi = lo\n\t}\n\tif hi <= 0 {\n\t\treturn 0\n\t}\n\treturn lo + n.rng.Int63n(hi-lo+1)\n}\n\n// Send handles one copy from m.From to to at virtual time now. It records a\n// Decision and, unless dropped, schedules one (or two) arrivals through Sink.\nfunc (n *Network) Send(now int64, to string, m *node.Message) {\n\tarrival := func(d int64) {\n\t\tn.sink(now+d, to, m)\n\t}\n\tdecision := Decision{\n\t\tTime:   now,\n\t\tFrom:   m.From,\n\t\tTo:     to,\n\t\tOrigin: m.Origin.String(),\n\t}\n\n\tif f, ok := n.match(m, to); ok {\n\t\tdecision.Reason = \"fault\"\n\t\tswitch Action(f.Action) {\n\t\tcase ActionDropped:\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDropped\n\t\tcase ActionDuplicate:\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDuplicate\n\t\t\td := f.DelayMs\n\t\t\tif d < 0 {\n\t\t\t\td = n.delay()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tdecision.DelayMs = d\n\t\t\tarrival(d)\n\t\t\tarrival(d + 1) // distinct arrival times, still a true duplicate copy\n\t\tcase \"delay\":\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDelivered\n\t\t\tdecision.DelayMs = f.DelayMs\n\t\t\tarrival(f.DelayMs)\n\t\tdefault: // \"delivered\"\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDelivered\n\t\t\td := f.DelayMs\n\t\t\tif d < 0 {\n\t\t\t\td = n.delay()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tdecision.DelayMs = d\n\t\t\tarrival(d)\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.log = append(n.log, decision)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Stochastic policy: fixed draw order per copy -> reproducible.\n\tdecision.Reason = \"random\"\n\tif r := n.rng.Float64(); r < n.policy.LossRate {\n\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDropped\n\t\tn.log = append(n.log, decision)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\td := n.delay()\n\tdecision.DelayMs = d\n\tif r := n.rng.Float64(); r < n.policy.DuplicateRate {\n\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDuplicate\n\t\tarrival(d)\n\t\tarrival(d + 1)\n\t} else {\n\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDelivered\n\t\tarrival(d)\n\t}\n\tn.log = append(n.log, decision)\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":127,"oldLines":10,"newStart":127,"newLines":9,"lines":["   if f, ok := n.match(m, to); ok {","     decision.Reason = \"fault\"","     switch Action(f.Action) {","-    case ActionDropped:","+    case \"drop\":","       decision.Action = ActionDropped","-    case ActionDuplicate:","-      decision.Action = ActionDuplicate","+    case \"duplicate\":","       d := f.DelayMs","       if d < 0 {","         d = n.delay()"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"a3ec8ac2-fd37-4d01-8fb4-08f6da9c41ef","session_id":"a95586de-a3d7-48b7-82d9-97f45b1b0417","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp28/b","sessionId":"a95586de-a3d7-48b7-82d9-97f45b1b0417","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp28-b","slug":"mellow-squishing-hickey"}

Loss,\n// duplication and reordering therefore arise naturally from per-copy delays\n// rather than from any real cluster or wall-clock timing.\npackage simnet\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/node\"\n)\n\n// Action describes what the network did with one copy.\ntype Action string\n\nconst (\n\tActionDelivered Action = \"delivered\" // one copy scheduled\n\tActionDuplicate Action = \"duplicate\" // two copies scheduled (independent arrival paths)\n\tActionDropped   Action = \"dropped\"   // copy discarded\n)\n\n// Policy is the seeded stochastic part of the network. Rates are in [0,1].\ntype Policy struct {\n\tLossRate     float64 `json:\"loss_rate\"`\n\tDuplicateRate float64 `json:\"duplicate_rate\"`\n\tMinDelayMs   int64   `json:\"min_delay_ms\"`\n\tMaxDelayMs   int64   `json:\"max_delay_ms\"`\n}\n\n// Fault is an explicit, deterministic override matching individual copies.\n// Empty string / 0 in a matcher means wildcard; -1 in DelayMs means\n// \"no override\". First matching fault wins; stochastic policy is only\n// consulted when no fault matches.\ntype Fault struct {\n\tOriginNode string `json:\"origin_node,omitempty\"`\n\tOriginSeq  int    `json:\"origin_seq,omitempty\"`\n\tFrom       string `json:\"from,omitempty\"`\n\tTo         string `json:\"to,omitempty\"`\n\tAction     string `json:\"action\"`               // deliver | drop | duplicate | delay\n\tDelayMs    int64  `json:\"delay_ms,omitempty\"`  // for action=delay\n}\n\n// Decision is the logged outcome of one Send call.\ntype Decision struct {\n\tTime     int64  `json:\"time\"`\n\tFrom     string `json:\"from\"`\n\tTo       string `json:\"to\"`\n\tOrigin   string `json:\"origin\"`\n\tAction   Action `json:\"action\"`\n\tDelayMs  int64  `json:\"delay_ms,omitempty\"`\n\tReason   string `json:\"reason\"` // \"fault\" or \"random\"\n}\n\n// Sink receives scheduled arrivals. The engine supplies it so the network\n// stays free of simulator/event-package imports.\ntype Sink func(arrivalTime int64, to string, m *node.Message)\n\n// Network applies faults + random policy and schedules copies via Sink.\ntype Network struct {\n\tpolicy Policy\n\tfaults []Fault\n\trng    *rand.Rand\n\tsink   Sink\n\tlog    []Decision\n}\n\n// New builds a network. rng is shared and advanced deterministically (one\n// draw block per Send, nodes traversed in sorted order by the engine).\nfunc New(policy Policy, faults []Fault, rng *rand.Rand, sink Sink) *Network {\n\treturn &Network{policy: policy, faults: faults, rng: rng, sink: sink}\n}\n\n// Log returns all per-copy decisions in send order.\nfunc (n *Network) Log() []Decision { return n.log }\n\nfunc (n *Network) match(m *node.Message, to string) (*Fault, bool) {\n\tfor i := range n.faults {\n\t\tf := &n.faults[i]\n\t\tif f.OriginNode != \"\" && f.OriginNode != m.Origin.Node {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif f.OriginSeq != 0 && f.OriginSeq != m.Origin.Seq {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\t// An omitted From anchors the fault to the FIRST hop: it matches\n\t\t// only copies sent by the message originator. Set From explicitly\n\t\t// to target relay (gossip) copies from another holder.\n\t\tfrom := f.From\n\t\tif from == \"\" {\n\t\t\tfrom = m.Origin.Node\n\t\t}\n\t\tif from != m.From {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif f.To != \"\" && f.To != to {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn f, true\n\t}\n\treturn nil, false\n}\n\nfunc (n *Network) delay() int64 {\n\tlo, hi := n.policy.MinDelayMs, n.policy.MaxDelayMs\n\tif hi < lo {\n\t\thi = lo\n\t}\n\tif hi <= 0 {\n\t\treturn 0\n\t}\n\treturn lo + n.rng.Int63n(hi-lo+1)\n}\n\n// Send handles one copy from m.From to to at virtual time now. It records a\n// Decision and, unless dropped, schedules one (or two) arrivals through Sink.\nfunc (n *Network) Send(now int64, to string, m *node.Message) {\n\tarrival := func(d int64) {\n\t\tn.sink(now+d, to, m)\n\t}\n\tdecision := Decision{\n\t\tTime:   now,\n\t\tFrom:   m.From,\n\t\tTo:     to,\n\t\tOrigin: m.Origin.String(),\n\t}\n\n\tif f, ok := n.match(m, to); ok {\n\t\tdecision.Reason = \"fault\"\n\t\tswitch Action(f.Action) {\n\t\tcase \"drop\":\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDropped\n\t\tcase \"duplicate\":\n\t\t\td := f.DelayMs\n\t\t\tif d < 0 {\n\t\t\t\td = n.delay()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tdecision.DelayMs = d\n\t\t\tarrival(d)\n\t\t\tarrival(d + 1) // distinct arrival times, still a true duplicate copy\n\t\tcase \"delay\":\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDelivered\n\t\t\tdecision.DelayMs = f.DelayMs\n\t\t\tarrival(f.DelayMs)\n\t\tdefault: // \"delivered\"\n\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDelivered\n\t\t\td := f.DelayMs\n\t\t\tif d < 0 {\n\t\t\t\td = n.delay()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tdecision.DelayMs = d\n\t\t\tarrival(d)\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.log = append(n.log, decision)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// Stochastic policy: fixed draw order per copy -> reproducible.\n\tdecision.Reason = \"random\"\n\tif r := n.rng.Float64(); r < n.policy.LossRate {\n\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDropped\n\t\tn.log = append(n.log, decision)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\td := n.delay()\n\tdecision.DelayMs = d\n\tif r := n.rng.Float64(); r < n.policy.DuplicateRate {\n\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDuplicate\n\t\tarrival(d)\n\t\tarrival(d + 1)\n\t} else {\n\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDelivered\n\t\tarrival(d)\n\t}\n\tn.log = append(n.log, decision)\n}\n","structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":130,"oldLines":6,"newStart":130,"newLines":7,"lines":["     case \"drop\":","       decision.Action = ActionDropped","     case \"duplicate\":","+      decision.Action = ActionDuplicate","       d := f.DelayMs","       if d < 0 {","         d = n.delay()"]}],"userModified":false,"replaceAll":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"e7837be8-b98f-49c1-8658-e36d48c74cc8","session_id":"a95586de-a3d7-48b7-82d9-97f45b1b0417","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp28/b","sessionId":"a95586de-a3d7-48b7-82d9-97f45b1b0417","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp28-b","slug":"mellow-squishing-hickey"}

m1\n// then arrives and must release m2 in order.\nfunc TestBufferThenRelease(t *testing.T) {\n\tn := New(\"n3\", 16)\n\tm1 := mkMsg(vec.Key{\"n1\", 1})\n\tm2 := mkMsg(vec.Key{\"n1\", 2}, vec.Key{\"n1\", 1})\n\n\tout, buffered, _ := n.Handle(10, m2)\n\tif out != Buffered || n.BufferLen() != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"m2 should buffer, got %v len=%d\", out, n.BufferLen())\n\t}\n\n\tout, delivered, _ := n.Handle(11, m1)\n\tif out != Delivered || len(delivered) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"m1 should deliver and release m2, got %v n=%d\", out, len(delivered))\n\t}\n\tif delivered[0].Origin != m1.Origin || delivered[1].Origin != m2.Origin {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"release order wrong: %v then %v\", delivered[0].Origin, delivered[1].Origin)\n\t}\n\tif !n.Clock().Has(vec.Key{\"n1\", 2}) {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"clock should advance to n1:2\")\n\t}\n}\n\n// Duplicate copies of a delivered message, and of one already buffered, must\n// be suppressed exactly once each.\nfunc TestDuplicatesSuppressed(t *testing.T) {\n\tn := New(\"n3\", 16)\n\tm1 := mkMsg(vec.Key{\"n1\", 1})\n\tm2 := mkMsg(vec.Key{\"n1\", 2}, vec.Key{\"n1\", 1})\n\n\tif out, _, _ := n.Handle(0, m2); out != Buffered {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"first m2 should buffer\")\n\t}\n\tif out, _, _ := n.Handle(1, m2); out != Duplicate {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"duplicate buffered copy, got %v\", out)\n\t}\n\tif n.BufferLen() != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"duplicate must not be stored\")\n\t}\n\n\tif out, _, _ := n.Handle(2, m1); out != Delivered {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"m1 deliver\")\n\t}\n\tif out, _, _ := n.Handle(3, m1); out != Duplicate {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"duplicate delivered copy, got %v\", out)\n\t}\n\tif out, _, _ := n.Handle(4, m2); out != Duplicate {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"late m2 after release must be duplicate, got %v\", out)\n\t}\n\tif n.DuplicateCount() != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"dup count = %d, want 3\", n.DuplicateCount())\n\t}\n\tif n.DeliveriesCount() != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"distinct deliveries = %d, want 2\", n.DeliveriesCount())\n\t}\n}\n\n// When the bounded buffer is full, a not-ready copy returns Backpressure and\n// must NOT mutate state; a later retry after the predecessor arrives delivers.\nfunc TestBackpressureDoesNotBreakOrder(t *testing.T) {\n\tn := New(\"n3\", 1)\n\tm1 := mkMsg(vec.Key{\"n1\", 1})\n\tm2 := mkMsg(vec.Key{\"n1\", 2}, vec.Key{\"n1\", 1})\n\tm3 := mkMsg(vec.Key{\"n1\", 3}, vec.Key{\"n1\", 1}, vec.Key{\"n1\", 2})\n\n\t// m2 fills the single slot.\n\tif out, _, _ := n.Handle(0, m2); out != Buffered {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"m2 buffer\")\n\t}\n\t// m3 not ready and buffer full -> backpressure, rejected, not stored.\n\tout, _, bp := n.Handle(1, m3)\n\tif out != Backpressure || bp == nil || n.BufferLen() != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"m3 should hit backpressure without buffering, got %v len=%d\", out, n.BufferLen())\n\t}\n\tif len(bp.WaitingOn) == 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"backpressure event should report waiting_on\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Predecessor m1 arrives: releases m2; m3 was not buffered so its retry\n\t// (fresh copy) now also delivers, in order.\n\tif out, delivered, _ := n.Handle(2, m1); out != Delivered || len(delivered) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"m1 should deliver + release m2, got %v n=%d\", out, len(delivered))\n\t}\n\tout, delivered, _ := n.Handle(3, m3)\n\tif out != Delivered || len(delivered) != 1 || delivered[0].Origin != m3.Origin {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"retry m3 should deliver, got %v %v\", out, delivered)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Cross-origin causal dependency: n2's message depends on n1's; n1 late.\nfunc TestCrossOriginCausality(t *testing.T) {\n\tn := New(\"n3\", 16)\n\ta := mkMsg(vec.Key{\"n1\", 1})\n\tb := mkMsg(vec.Key{\"n2\", 1}, vec.Key{\"n1\", 1}) // n2 had seen n1:1\n\n\tif out, _, _ := n.Handle(0, b); out != Buffered {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"b must wait for a\")\n\t}\n\tout, delivered, _ := n.Handle(1, a)\n\tif out != Delivered || len(delivered) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"a should release b, got %v n=%d\", out, len(delivered))\n\t}\n\tif delivered[1].Origin.Node != \"n2\" {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"b must be delivered after a\")\n\t}\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_49217fe7957f489337062140","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1574,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":86840,"output_tokens":2151,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_p5xzzlmw5mt0hzjrbb5qx5iu":{"content":"package node\n\nimport (\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/vec\"\n)\n\nfunc mkMsg(origin vec.Key, deps ...vec.Key) *Message {\n\treturn &Message{Origin: origin, Sender: origin.Node, From: \"x\", Deps: deps}\n}\n\n// Out-of-order arrival: m2 depends on m1. m2 arrives first and buffers; out != Buffered {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"m2 buffer\")\n\t}\n\t// m3 not ready and buffer full -> backpressure, rejected, not stored.\n\tout, _, bp := n.Handle(1, m3)\n\tif out != Backpressure || bp == nil || n.BufferLen() != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"m3 should hit backpressure without buffering, got %v len=%d\", out, n.BufferLen())\n\t}\n\tif len(bp.WaitingOn) == 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"backpressure event should report waiting_on\")\n\t}\n\n\t// Predecessor m1 arrives: releases m2; m3 was not buffered so its retry\n\t// (fresh copy) now also delivers, in order.\n\tif out, delivered, _ := n.Handle(2, m1); out != Delivered || len(delivered) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"m1 should deliver + release m2, got %v n=%d\", out, len(delivered))\n\t}\n\tout, delivered, _ := n.Handle(3, m3)\n\tif out != Delivered || len(delivered) != 1 || delivered[0].Origin != m3.Origin {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"retry m3 should deliver, got %v %v\", out, delivered)\n\t}\n}\n\n// Cross-origin causal dependency: n2's message depends on n1's; n1 late.\nfunc TestCrossOriginCausality(t *testing.T) {\n\tn := New(\"n3\", 16)\n\ta := mkMsg(vec.Key{\"n1\", 1})\n\tb := mkMsg(vec.Key{\"n2\", 1}, vec.Key{\"n1\", 1}) // n2 had seen n1:1\n\n\tif out, _, _ := n.Handle(0, b); out != Buffered {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"b must wait for a\")\n\t}\n\tout, delivered, _ := n.Handle(1, a)\n\tif out != Delivered || len(delivered) != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"a should release b, got %v n=%d\", out, len(delivered))\n\t}\n\tif delivered[1].Origin.Node != \"n2\" {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"b must be delivered after a\")\n\t}\n}\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"d709d8ae-8087-4d80-9599-ca9cc7387284","session_id":"a95586de-a3d7-48b7-82d9-97f45b1b0417","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp28/b","sessionId":"a95586de-a3d7-48b7-82d9-97f45b1b0417","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp28-b","slug":"mellow-squishing-hickey"}

{"parentUuid":"688bf369-7840-4cb3-a12c-44030c4ef275","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_1xl9uxirb5jwz71wmkxzcpa0","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp28/b/internal/engine/engine_acceptance_test.go","content":"package engine\n\nimport (\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"testing\"\n\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/vec\"\n)\n\n// assertCausal verifies, per node, that every delivery is causally legal:\n// before delivering m, all non-self dependencies and the same-origin\n// predecessor must already appear earlier in that node's delivery list.\nfunc assertCausal(t *testing.T, r *Response) {\n\tt.Helper()\n\tseen := map[string]map[vec.Key]bool{}\n\tfor _, id := range r.Nodes {\n\t\tseen[id] = map[vec.Key]bool{}\n\t}\n\tfor _, d := range r.Deliveries {\n\t\ts := seen[d.Node]\n\t\tfor _, dep := range depsOf(r, d.Origin) {\n\t\t\tif dep.Node == d.Origin.Node {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif !s[dep] {\n\t\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"CAUSAL VIOLATION node=%s delivered %s before dependency %s\",\n\t\t\t\t\td.Node, d.Origin, dep)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tpred := vec.Key{Node: d.Origin.Node, Seq: d.Origin.Seq - 1}\n\t\tif pred.Seq > 0 && !s[pred] {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"CAUSAL VIOLATION node=%s delivered %s before predecessor %s\",\n\t\t\t\td.Node, d.Origin, pred)\n\t\t}\n\t\ts[d.Origin] = true\n\t}\n}\n\n// depsOf reconstructs the dependency vector from the first delivery record\n// of an origin (its clock_after minus itself equals its causal past).\nfunc depsOf(r *Response, k vec.Key) []vec.Key {\n\tfor _, d := range r.Deliveries {\n\t\tif d.Origin == k && d.Node == k.Node {\n\t\t\tout := []vec.Key{}\n\t\t\tfor n, max := range d.Clock {\n\t\t\t\tfor s := 1; s <= max; s++ {\n\t\t\t\t\tkk := vec.Key{Node: n, Seq: s}\n\t\t\t\t\tif kk != k {\n\t\t\t\t\t\tout = append(out, kk)\n\t\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\treturn out\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc deliveriesAt(r *Response, node string) []vec.Key {\n\tvar out []vec.Key\n\tfor _, d := range r.Deliveries {\n\t\tif d.Node == node {\n\t\t\tout = append(out, d.Origin)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\nfunc baseReq() *Request {\n\treturn &Request{\n\t\tSeed:      1,\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"n1\", \"n2\", \"n3\"},\n\t\tEndTimeMs: 100,\n\t\tNetwork:  PolicyNoFaults(),\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestAcceptChainBufferRelease: chain generated by a trigger; n3 receives the\n// root very late (30ms); the child must never deliver at n3 before the root,\n// and after release both land in causal order.\nfunc TestAcceptChainBufferRelease(t *testing.T) {\n\treq := baseReq()\n\treq.Topology = map[string][]string{\n\t\t\"n1\": {\"n2\", \"n3\"}, \"n2\": {\"n3\"}, \"n3\": {},\n\t}\n\treq.Faults = []faultShim{\n\t\t{origin: \"n1\", seq: 1, from: \"n1\", to: \"n3\", action: \"delay\", delayMs: 30},\n\t\t{origin: \"n1\", seq: 1, from: \"n1\", to: \"n2\", action: \"deliver\", delayMs: 2},\n\t}.toFaults()\n\treq.Broadcasts = []BroadcastSpec{{AtMs: 0, Node: \"n1\", Payload: \"root\"}}\n\treq.Triggers = []TriggerSpec{\n\t\t{WhenNode: \"n2\", AfterOrigin: vec.Key{\"n1\", 1}, Payload: \"child\"},\n\t}\n\tr := Run(req)\n\tif r.Status != \"ok\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"run error: %s\", r.Error)\n\t}\n\tassertCausal(t, r)\n\n\tn3 := deliveriesAt(r, \"n3\")\n\tif len(n3) != 2 || n3[0] != (vec.Key{\"n1\", 1}) || n3[1] != (vec.Key{\"n2\", 1}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"n3 delivery order wrong: %v\", n3)\n\t}\n\t// Root arrived at t=30 at n3; child released in the same or a later event.\n\tvar rootT, childT int64\n\tfor _, d := range r.Deliveries {\n\t\tswitch d.Origin {\n\t\tcase vec.Key{\"n1\", 1}:\n\t\t\tif d.Node == \"n3\" {\n\t\t\t\trootT = d.Time\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase vec.Key{\"n2\", 1}:\n\t\t\tif d.Node == \"n3\" {\n\t\t\t\tchildT = d.Time\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif rootT != 30 || childT < 30 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"release timing root=%d child=%d\", rootT, childT)\n\t}\n\tif len(r.Final.RootMissingBlockers) != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"unexpected missing blockers: %v\", r.Final.RootMissingBlockers)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestAcceptConcurrentReorderDuplicate: two independent broadcasts cross; n3\n// receives n2's before n1's (20ms reorder) and n4 gets a duplicated copy.\n// Delivery must stay causal and duplicates are suppressed.\nfunc TestAcceptConcurrentReorderDuplicate(t *testing.T) {\n\treq := &Request{\n\t\tSeed:      7,\n\t\tNodes:     []string{\"n1\", \"n2\", \"n3\", \"n4\"},\n\t\tEndTimeMs: 100,\n\t\tTopology: map[string][]string{\n\t\t\t\"n1\": {\"n3\", \"n4\"}, \"n2\": {\"n3\", \"n4\"}, \"n3\": {}, \"n4\": {},\n\t\t},\n\t\tNetwork: PolicyNoFaults(),\n\t\tFaults: []faultShim{\n\t\t\t{origin: \"n1\", seq: 1, from: \"n1\", to: \"n3\", action: \"delay\", delayMs: 20},\n\t\t\t{origin: \"n2\", seq: 1, from: \"n2\", to: \"n3\", action: \"deliver\", delayMs: 2},\n\t\t\t{origin: \"n2\", seq: 1, from: \"n2\", to: \"n4\", action: \"duplicate\", delayMs: 5},\n\t\t}.toFaults(),\n\t\tBroadcasts: []BroadcastSpec{\n\t\t\t{AtMs: 0, Node: \"n1\", Payload: \"a\"},\n\t\t\t{AtMs: 0, Node: \"n2\", Payload: \"b\"},\n\t\t},\n\t}\n\tr := Run(req)\n\tif r.Status != \"ok\" {\n\t\tt.Fatal(r.Error)\n\t}\n\tassertCausal(t, r)\n\n\tn3 := deliveriesAt(r, \"n3\")\n\tif len(n3) != 2 || n3[0] != (vec.Key{\"n2\", 1}) || n3[1] != (vec.Key{\"n1\", 1}) {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected reordered concurrent delivery n2:1 then n1:1, got %v\", n3)\n\t}\n\tif r.Duplicates[\"n4\"] == 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatal(\"n4 should have suppressed a duplicated copy\")\n\t}\n\tcount := map[vec.Key]int{}\n\tfor _, d := range r.Deliveries {\n\t\tif d.Node == \"n4\" {\n\t\t\tcount[d.Origin]++\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor k, c := range count {\n\t\tif c != 1 {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"n4 delivered %s %d times\", k, c)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestAcceptLossThenRepair: first-hop copies to n2/n3 are dropped; they hold\n// nothing until the explicit retransmit at t=40, then both deliver. s <= max; s++ {\n47\t\t\t\t\t\tkk := vec.Key{Node: n, Seq: s}\n48\t\t\t\t\t\tif kk != k {\n49\t\t\t\t\t\t\tout = append(out, kk)\n50\t\t\t\t\t\t}\n51\t\t\t\t\t}\n52\t\t\t\t}\n53\t\t\t\treturn out\n54\t\t\t}\n55\t\t}\n56\t\treturn nil\n57\t}\n58\t\n59\tfunc deliveriesAt(r *Response, node string) []vec.Key {\n60\t\tvar out []vec.Key\n61\t\tfor _, d := range r.Deliveries {\n62\t\t\tif d.Node == node {\n63\t\t\t\tout = append(out, d.Origin)\n64\t\t\t}\n65\t\t}\n66\t\treturn out\n67\t}\n68\t\n69\tfunc baseReq() *Request {\n70\t\treturn &Request{\n71\t\t\tSeed:      1,\n72\t\t\tNodes:     []string{\"n1\", \"n2\", \"n3\"},\n73\t\t\tEndTimeMs: 100,\n74\t\t\tNetwork:  PolicyNoFaults(),\n75\t\t}\n76\t}\n77\t\n78\t// TestAcceptChainBufferRelease: chain generated by a trigger; n1 late.\nfunc TestCrossOriginCausality(t *testing.T) {\n\tn := New(\"n3\", 16)\n\ta := mkMsg(vec.Key{\"n1\", 1})\n\tb := mkMsg(vec.Key{\"n2\", 1}, vec.Key{\"n1\", 1}) // n2 had seen n1:1\n\n\tif out, _, _ := n.Handle(0, b); Loss,\n3\t// duplication and reordering therefore arise naturally from per-copy delays\n4\t// rather than from any real cluster or wall-clock timing.\n5\tpackage simnet\n6\t\n7\timport (\n8\t\t\"math/rand\"\n9\t\n10\t\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/node\"\n11\t)\n12\t\n13\t// Action describes what the network did with one copy.\n14\ttype Action string\n15\t\n16\tconst (\n17\t\tActionDelivered Action = \"delivered\" // one copy scheduled\n18\t\tActionDuplicate Action = \"duplicate\" // two copies scheduled (independent arrival paths)\n19\t\tActionDropped   Action = \"dropped\"   // copy discarded\n20\t)\n21\t\n22\t// Policy is the seeded stochastic part of the network. The engine supplies it so the network\n55\t// stays free of simulator/event-package imports.\n56\ttype Sink func(arrivalTime int64, to string, m *node.Message)\n57\t\n58\t// Network applies faults + random policy and schedules copies via Sink.\n59\ttype Network struct {\n60\t\tpolicy Policy\n61\t\tfaults []Fault\n62\t\trng    *rand.Rand\n63\t\tsink   Sink\n64\t\tlog    []Decision\n65\t}\n66\t\n67\t// New builds a network. rng is shared and advanced deterministically (one\n68\t// draw block per Send, nodes traversed in sorted order by the engine).\n69\tfunc New(policy Policy, faults []Fault, rng *rand.Rand, sink Sink) *Network {\n70\t\treturn &Network{policy: policy, faults: faults, rng: rng, sink: sink}\n71\t}\n72\t\n73\t// Log returns all per-copy decisions in send order.\n74\tfunc (n *Network) Log() []Decision { return n.log }\n75\t\n76\tfunc (n *Network) match(m *node.Message, to string) (*Fault, bool) {\n77\t\tfor i := range n.faults {\n78\t\t\tf := &n.faults[i]\n79\t\t\tif f.OriginNode != \"\" && f.OriginNode != m.Origin.Node {\n80\t\t\t\tcontinue\n81\t\t\t}\n82\t\t\tif f.OriginSeq != 0 && f.OriginSeq != m.Origin.Seq {\n83\t\t\t\tcontinue\n84\t\t\t}\n85\t\t\t// An omitted From anchors the fault to the FIRST hop: it matches\n86\t\t\t// only copies sent by the message originator. Set From explicitly\n87\t\t\t// to target relay (gossip) copies from another holder.\n88\t\t\tfrom := f.From\n89\t\t\tif from == \"\" {\n90\t\t\t\tfrom = m.Origin.Node\n91\t\t\t}\n92\t\t\tif from != m.From {\n93\t\t\t\tcontinue\n94\t\t\t}\n95\t\t\tif f.To != \"\" && f.To != to {\n96\t\t\t\tcontinue\n97\t\t\t}\n98\t\t\treturn f, true\n99\t\t}\n100\t\treturn nil, false\n101\t}\n102\t\n103\tfunc (n *Network) delay() int64 {\n104\t\tlo, hi := n.policy.MinDelayMs, n.policy.MaxDelayMs\n105\t\tif hi < lo {\n106\t\t\thi = lo\n107\t\t}\n108\t\tif hi <= 0 {\n109\t\t\treturn 0\n110\t\t}\n111\t\treturn lo + n.rng.Int63n(hi-lo+1)\n112\t}\n113\t\n114\t// Send handles one copy from m.From to to at virtual time now. ok {\n128\t\t\tdecision.Reason = \"fault\"\n129\t\t\tswitch Action(f.Action) {\n130\t\t\tcase \"drop\":\n131\t\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDropped\n132\t\t\tcase \"duplicate\":\n133\t\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDuplicate\n134\t\t\t\td := f.DelayMs\n135\t\t\t\tif d < 0 {\n136\t\t\t\t\td = n.delay()\n137\t\t\t\t}\n138\t\t\t\tdecision.DelayMs = d\n139\t\t\t\tarrival(d)\n140\t\t\t\tarrival(d + 1) // distinct arrival times, still a true duplicate copy\n141\t\t\tcase \"delay\":\n142\t\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDelivered\n143\t\t\t\tdecision.DelayMs = f.DelayMs\n144\t\t\t\tarrival(f.DelayMs)\n145\t\t\tdefault: // \"delivered\"\n146\t\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDelivered\n147\t\t\t\td := f.DelayMs\n148\t\t\t\tif d < 0 {\n149\t\t\t\t\td = n.delay()\n150\t\t\t\t}\n151\t\t\t\tdecision.DelayMs = d\n152\t\t\t\tarrival(d)\n153\t\t\t}\n154\t\t\tn.log = append(n.log, decision)\n155\t\t\treturn\n156\t\t}\n157\t\n158\t\t// Stochastic policy: fixed draw order per copy -> reproducible.\n159\t\tdecision.Reason = \"random\"\n160\t\tif r := n.rng.Float64(); r < n.policy.LossRate {\n161\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDropped\n162\t\t\tn.log = append(n.log, decision)\n163\t\t\treturn\n164\t\t}\n165\t\td := n.delay()\n166\t\tdecision.DelayMs = d\n167\t\tif r := n.rng.Float64(); r < n.policy.DuplicateRate {\n168\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDuplicate\n169\t\t\tarrival(d)\n170\t\t\tarrival(d + 1)\n171\t\t} else {\n172\t\t\tdecision.Action = ActionDelivered\n173\t\t\tarrival(d)\n174\t\t}\n175\t\tn.log = append(n.log, decision)\n176\t}"},"type":"attachment","uuid":"950a75f1-b461-4de6-b5ab-d25758031d96","timestamp":"2026-09-23T05:14:07.517Z","rendered":[{"content":"<system-reminder>\nNote: /home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp28/b/internal/simnet/network.go changed on disk since you last read it. for inspection)\n\tPayload string    `json:\"payload\"`\n}\n\n// Delivery records one successful application-level delivery.\ntype Delivery struct {\n\tTime    int64     `json:\"time\"`\n\tNode    string    `json:\"node\"`\n\tOrigin  vec.Key   `json:\"origin\"`\n\tPayload string    `json:\"payload\"`\n\tClock   vec.Clock `json:\"clock_after\"`\n}\n\n// Outcome classifies what a node does with an incoming copy.\ntype Outcome int\n\nconst (\n\t// Delivered means this copy (or buffered messages it unblocked) was applied.\n\tDelivered Outcome = iota\n\t// Buffered means the message is held waiting for missing dependencies.\n\tBuffered\n\t// Duplicate means this message was already delivered; the copy is dropped.\n\tDuplicate\n\t// Backpressure means dependencies are missing AND the buffer is full;\n\t// the message is rejected and NOT retained (retry may arrive later).\n\tBackpressure\n)\n\n// BackpressureEvent captures one rejected copy for diagnostics.\ntype BackpressureEvent struct {\n\tTime      int64     `json:\"time\"`\n\tNode      string    `json:\"node\"`\n\tOrigin    vec.Key   `json:\"origin\"`\n\tCapacity  int       `json:\"capacity\"`\n\tWaitingOn []vec.Key `json:\"waiting_on\"`\n}\n\n// Node is a single simulated process.\ntype Node struct {\n\tID        string\n\tclock     vec.Clock\n\tbuffer    map[vec.Key]*Message\n\tdelivered map[vec.Key]bool\n\tcap       int\n\n\t// Counters/logs\n\tdupCount     int\n\tbackpressure []BackpressureEvent\n}\n\n// New creates a node with a hold-back buffer bounded by capacity (<=0 means\n// unbounded).\nfunc New(id string, capacity int) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tID:        id,\n\t\tclock:     vec.Clock{},\n\t\tbuffer:    map[vec.Key]*Message{},\n\t\tdelivered: map[vec.Key]bool{},\n\t\tcap:       capacity,\n\t}\n}\n\n// Clock returns a copy of the node's delivered vector clock.\nfunc (n *Node) Clock() vec.Clock { return n.clock.Clone() }\n\n// BufferLen returns the number of messages currently held back.\nfunc (n *Node) BufferLen() int { return len(n.buffer) }\n\n// BufferKeys returns the origins currently buffered, deterministically sorted.\nfunc (n *Node) BufferKeys() []vec.Key {\n\tout := make([]vec.Key, 0, len(n.buffer))\n\tfor k := range n.buffer {\n\t\tout = append(out, k)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(out, func(i, j int) bool { return out[i].Less(out[j]) })\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// {\n\tout := map[string][]vec.Key{}\n\tfor _, k := range n.BufferKeys() {\n\t\tm := n.buffer[k]\n\t\tmiss := vec.MissingDeps(n.clock, m.Deps)\n\t\tif len(miss) > 0 {\n\t\t\tout[k.String()] = miss\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn out\n}\n\n// DuplicateCount returns how many duplicate copies were suppressed.\nfunc (n *Node) DuplicateCount() int { return n.dupCount }\n\n// BackpressureEvents returns the log of rejected copies.\nfunc (n *Node) BackpressureEvents() []BackpressureEvent { return n.backpressure }\n\n// Broadcast constructs a new message originating at this node. seq is the\n// node's next per-origin sequence number and is supplied by the engine.\nfunc (n *Node) Broadcast(seq int, payload string) *Message {\n\tk := vec.Key{Node: n.ID, Seq: seq}\n\tdeps := n.clock.Deps()\n\treturn &Message{\n\t\tOrigin:  k,\n\t\tSender:  n.ID,\n\t\tFrom:    n.ID,\n\t\tDeps:    deps,\n\t\tClock:   n.clock.Clone(),\n\t\tPayload: payload,\n\t}\n}\n\n// ready reports whether all non-self dependencies are satisfied and the\n// predecessor from the same origin (seq-1) has been delivered. A message is\n// not required to \"depend on itself\": the origin entry is checked via seq-1,\n// as in standard causal-broadcast delivery.\nfunc ready(clock vec.Clock, m *Message) []vec.Key {\n\tvar miss []vec.Key\n\tfor _, k := range m.Deps {\n\t\tif k.Node == m.Origin.Node {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif !clock.Has(k) {\n\t\t\tmiss = append(miss, k)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tpred := vec.Key{Node: m.Origin.Node, Seq: m.Origin.Seq - 1}\n\tif pred.Seq > 0 && !clock.Has(pred) {\n\t\tmiss = append(miss, pred)\n\t}\n\tsort.Slice(miss, func(i, j int) bool { return miss[i].Less(miss[j]) })\n\treturn miss\n}\n\n// Handle processes one incoming copy at virtual time t. It returns the\n// outcome, zero or more newly delivered messages (the incoming one first,\n// then any buffered messages released by it, in causal-safe order), and a\n// backpressure record when the outcome is Backpressure.\nfunc (n *Node) Handle(t int64, m *Message) (Outcome, []*Message, *BackpressureEvent) {\n\t// 1. De-duplication: delivered origins are accepted at most once; a copy\n\t// already sitting in the buffer is also a duplicate.\n\tif n.delivered[m.Origin] || n.buffer[m.Origin] != nil {\n\t\tn.dupCount++\n\t\treturn Duplicate, nil, nil\n\t}\n\n\t// 2. Causal readiness check against the delivered vector clock.\n\tmiss := ready(n.clock, m)\n\tif len(miss) == 0 {\n\t\tdelivered := n.deliver(m)\n\t\tdelivered = append(delivered, n.flush()...)\n\t\treturn Delivered, delivered, nil\n\t}\n\n\t// 3. Not ready: buffer, or reject with backpressure if the bounded\n\t// buffer is full. Rejection never mutates clock or buffer, so causal\n\t// order cannot be violated by a later retry.\n\tif n.cap > 0 && len(n.buffer) >= n.cap {\n\t\tbp := &BackpressureEvent{\n\t\t\tTime:      t,\n\t\t\tNode:      n.ID,\n\t\t\tOrigin:    m.Origin,\n\t\t\tCapacity:  n.cap,\n\t\t\tWaitingOn: miss,\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.backpressure = append(n.backpressure, *bp)\n\t\treturn Backpressure, nil, bp\n\t}\n\n\tcp := *m\n\tn.buffer[m.Origin] = &cp\n\treturn Buffered, nil, nil\n}\n\n// HandleLocal delivers a message originated at this node. A sender always\n// satisfies its own new message's dependencies; delivering it may also\n// release buffered dependents via flush.\nfunc (n *Node) HandleLocal(m *Message) []*Message {\n\tif n.delivered[m.Origin] || n.buffer[m.Origin] != nil {\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tdelivered := n.deliver(m)\n\tdelivered = append(delivered, n.flush()...)\n\treturn delivered\n}\n\n// deliver applies one ready message: observe it and return it.\nfunc (n *Node) deliver(m *Message) []*Message {\n\tn.clock.Observe(m.Origin)\n\tn.delivered[m.Origin] = true\n\treturn []*Message{m}\n}\n\n// flush repeatedly scans the buffer and delivers every message whose\n// dependencies are now satisfied, until a scan delivers nothing. {"parentUuid":"ab0cdecc-f1f6-4fb0-8522-46c29cf50384","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_4fn4rc28826pypzfxdxd12xr","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp28/b/README.md","content":"# causal-broadcast — 因果广播缓冲模拟器（纯后端）\n\n单进程内的**确定性离散事件模拟器**：多个节点在不可靠网络上做带向量依赖的\n因果广播；网络可丢包、重复、乱序；依赖未满足的先进缓冲，重复消息只投递一次，\n缓冲满时返回背压且不破坏因果顺序。**不依赖任何真实集群、网络或 wall-clock\n时间**——所有时序都是虚拟时钟，同一份 JSON 请求（含 seed）永远产出逐字节\n相同的结果。\n\n## 为什么用受限拓扑才能\"真正丢包\"\n\n默认是全互联 gossip，任意一跳丢失都会被其他持有节点的后续转发自然修复。\n为了让故障注入能表现出**不可自愈的丢失/永久缺失**，请求支持 `topology`\n有向邻接表；只有沿邻接边的复制会被发送，链路上的 `drop` 故障因此能造成\n真实不可达。\n\n## 目录结构\n\n```\ngo.mod\ncmd/cbsim/main.go                 # JSON 运行接口（CLI：-in/-out，也支持 stdin/stdout）\ninternal/\n  vec/clock.go                    # 向量钟、(node,seq) 键、依赖满足判定\n  sim/scheduler.go                # 确定性离散事件调度器（(时间, FIFO) 小顶堆）\n  simnet/network.go               # 不可靠网络：丢包/重复/延迟 + 显式故障注入\n  node/node.go                    # 因果投递、hold-back 缓冲、去重、背压\n  engine/engine.go                # 编排：拓扑、广播/触发器/重传、最终诊断\nexamples/                         # 5 个验收请求样例\nexamples/out/                     # 上述样例的实际运行结果（已提交）\nRUNLOG.md                         # 真实执行的命令、结果与未通过项记录\n```\n\n## 构建与运行\n\n```bash\ngo build -o bin/cbsim ./cmd/cbsim\n\n# 文件方式\n./bin/cbsim -in examples/01-chain-buffer-release.json -out /tmp/01.json\n\n# 管道方式\ncat examples/03-loss-repair.json | ./bin/cbsim > /tmp/03.json\n```\n\n退出码：`0` 正常（含仿真级校验错误，会以 `\"status\":\"error\"` 返回）；\n`1` JSON 无法解析 / 文件错误；`2` 请求校验失败。\n\n## 请求 JSON 字段\n\n| 字段 | 类型 | 说明 |\n|---|---|---|\n| `seed` | int | 随机网络的种子（同 seed 可复现） |\n| `nodes` | string[] | 节点 id，至少 2 个 |\n| `topology` | map(node→neighbors[]) | 可选，有向邻接表；缺省=全互联。给出时必须列出所有节点 |\n| `end_time_ms` | int | 虚拟仿真窗口；`t <= end_time_ms` 的事件都会执行 |\n| `buffer_capacity` | int | hold-back 缓冲容量；`0`=默认 16，`-1`=无限 |\n| `network` | object | `loss_rate`、`duplicate_rate` ∈ [0,1]，`min_delay_ms`/`max_delay_ms` |\n| `faults` | object[] | 确定性故障，逐条匹配（先匹配先生效） |\n| `broadcasts` | object[] | `{at_ms, node, payload}` 定时广播 |\n| `triggers` | object[] | `{when_node, after_origin:{node,seq}, payload}`：节点投递某消息后链式广播 |\n| `retransmits` | object[] | `{at_ms, from, from_origin, to[], delay_ms}`：从持有节点直接注入修复副本 |\n| `backpressure_retry` | object | `{delay_ms, max_attempts}`：`0`=放弃（默认），`-1`=无限重试 |\n\n故障匹配键：`origin_node` / `origin_seq` / `from` / `to`，留空为通配；\n**注意：省略 `from` 时锚定为\"源头直发\"（from=origin）**，要命中中继转发副本\n需显式写 `from`。`action` ∈ `deliver|drop|duplicate|delay`。\n\n## 响应 JSON 关键字段\n\n- `deliveries[]`：应用层投递记录（含投递时虚拟时间、节点、来源、投递后向量钟）。\n- `duplicates_suppressed_per_node`：每个节点丢弃的重复副本数。\n- `backpressure_events[]`：缓冲满时拒绝的副本及其 `waiting_on` 依赖。\n- `retry_events[]`：背压重试生命周期（`delivered|buffered|canceled|given_up`）。\n- `network_decisions[]`：每条复制副本网络做了什么（`delivered|duplicate|dropped`，\n  `fault` 或 `random`）。\n- `final_report`：\n  - `buffered_per_node` / `missing_for_buffered`：窗口结束仍在缓冲、各缺哪些前驱；\n  - `undelivered_origins`：至少一个节点未投递的消息；\n  - `root_missing_blockers`：**只有源头节点持有的消息**——无接收方能修复；\n  - `diagnostics`：人类可读的永久缺失/阻塞诊断。\n\n## 因果投递规则\n\n- 消息携带依赖向量：源节点广播时已投递的全部 `(node, seq)`。\n- 节点维护\"已投递向量钟\" V。消息 m（源 O、序号 s）可投递当且仅当：\n  1. 对每个非自身源的依赖 k 有 `V[k]` 满足；2. `V[O] >= s-1`（同源前驱）。\n- 不满足则进入 hold-back 缓冲；每当新消息投递，递归释放变就绪的缓冲消息。\n- 已投递或已缓冲的来源再次到达 → 计为重复并丢弃（恰好投递一次）。\n- 缓冲满且消息未就绪 → 背压拒绝，**不修改任何状态**，可安全重试。\n\n## 五个验收场景\n\n| 样例 | 验证点 |\n|---|---|\n| `01-chain-buffer-release` | 链式广播（触发器生成）；n3 先收到子消息，前驱延迟 30ms；前驱到齐后同一时刻按因果序释放 |\n| `02-concurrent-reorder-dup` | 并发广播；n3 先收 n2:1（2ms）后收 n1:1（20ms）=乱序；n4 收到重复副本且只投递一次 |\n| `03-loss-repair` | 前驱首跳全部 drop；40ms 由源重传，42ms 两节点补齐释放 |\n| `04-backpressure-retry` | 容量=1；后继先到触发背压，无限重试；前驱 40ms 到达后按序冲刷，且不违反因果 |\n| `05-permanent-loss-diagnosis` | n1:1 对 n3 超过窗口（500ms），n1:2 滞留缓冲；n1:3 对所有接收方丢失 → 报根阻塞与等待关系 |\n\n## 测试\n\n```bash\ngo test ./...          # 单元 + 端到端验收\ngo test -race ./...    # 竞态检测（本项目无 goroutine，应干净通过）\ngo vet ./...\n```\n\n测试覆盖：向量钟语义、缓冲释放、去重恰好一次、背压不破坏因果、跨源依赖、\n调度器 FIFO、五个验收场景、确定性复现（逐字段 DeepEqual）、请求校验错误。\n\n## 明确的边界（非目标）\n\n- 无前端、无网络服务监听；只有 CLI/库 + JSON。\n- 无真实节点、socket、集群；一切在单进程内用虚拟时间模拟。\n- 不实现真实成员管理/崩溃恢复；\"丢失\"指仿真窗口内不可达，重传由请求显式驱动。\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_f88a776da52a808569055252","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":724,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":121656,"output_tokens":1959,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_4fn4rc28826pypzfxdxd12xr":{"content":"#
