`nodes` | string[] | 节点 id，至少 2 个 |\n| `topology` | map(node→neighbors[]) | 可选，有向邻接表；缺省=全互联。给出时必须列出所有节点 |\n| `end_time_ms` | int | 虚拟仿真窗口；`t <= end_time_ms` 的事件都会执行 |\n| `buffer_capacity` | int | hold-back 缓冲容量；`0`=默认 16，`-1`=无限 |\n| `network` | object | `loss_rate`、`duplicate_rate` ∈ [0,1]，`min_delay_ms`/`max_delay_ms` |\n| `faults` | object[] | 确定性故障，逐条匹配（先匹配先生效） |\n| `broadcasts` | object[] | `{at_ms, node, payload}` 定时广播 |\n| `triggers` | object[] | `{when_node, after_origin:{node,seq}, payload}`：节点投递某消息后链式广播 |\n| `retransmits` | object[] | `{at_ms, from, from_origin, to[], delay_ms}`：从持有节点直接注入修复副本 |\n| `backpressure_retry` | object | `{delay_ms, max_attempts}`：`0`=放弃（默认），`-1`=无限重试 |\n\n故障匹配键：`origin_node` / `origin_seq` / `from` / `to`，留空为通配；\n**注意：省略 `from` 时锚定为\"源头直发\"（from=origin）**，要命中中继转发副本\n需显式写 `from`。`action` ∈ `deliver|drop|duplicate|delay`。\n\n## 响应 JSON 关键字段\n\n- `deliveries[]`：应用层投递记录（含投递时虚拟时间、节点、来源、投递后向量钟）。\n- `duplicates_suppressed_per_node`：每个节点丢弃的重复副本数。\n- `backpressure_events[]`：缓冲满时拒绝的副本及其 `waiting_on` 依赖。\n- `retry_events[]`：背压重试生命周期（`delivered|buffered|canceled|given_up`）。\n- `network_decisions[]`：每条复制副本网络做了什么（`delivered|duplicate|dropped`，\n  `fault` 或 `random`）。\n- `final_report`：\n  - `buffered_per_node` / `missing_for_buffered`：窗口结束仍在缓冲、各缺哪些前驱；\n  - `undelivered_origins`：至少一个节点未投递的消息；\n  - `root_missing_blockers`：**只有源头节点持有的消息**——无接收方能修复；\n  - `diagnostics`：人类可读的永久缺失/阻塞诊断。\n\n## 因果投递规则\n\n- 消息携带依赖向量：源节点广播时已投递的全部 `(node, seq)`。\n- 节点维护\"已投递向量钟\" V。消息 m（源 O、序号 s）可投递当且仅当：\n  1. 对每个非自身源的依赖 k 有 `V[k]` 满足；2. `V[O] >= s-1`（同源前驱）。\n- 不满足则进入 hold-back 缓冲；每当新消息投递，递归释放变就绪的缓冲消息。\n- 已投递或已缓冲的来源再次到达 → 计为重复并丢弃（恰好投递一次）。\n- 缓冲满且消息未就绪 → 背压拒绝，**不修改任何状态**，可安全重试。\n\n## 五个验收场景\n\n| 样例 | 验证点 |\n|---|---|\n| `01-chain-buffer-release` | 链式广播（触发器生成）；n3 先收到子消息，前驱延迟 30ms；前驱到齐后同一时刻按因果序释放 |\n| `02-concurrent-reorder-dup` | 并发广播；n3 先收 n2:1（2ms）后收 n1:1（20ms）=乱序；n4 收到重复副本且只投递一次 |\n| `03-loss-repair` | 前驱首跳全部 drop；40ms 由源重传，42ms 两节点补齐释放 |\n| `04-backpressure-retry` | 容量=1；后继先到触发背压，无限重试；前驱 40ms 到达后按序冲刷，且不违反因果 |\n| `05-permanent-loss-diagnosis` | n1:1 对 n3 超过窗口（500ms），n1:2 滞留缓冲；n1:3 对所有接收方丢失 → 报根阻塞与等待关系 |\n\n## 测试\n\n```bash\ngo test ./...          # 单元 + 端到端验收\ngo test -race ./...    # 竞态检测（本项目无 goroutine，应干净通过）\ngo vet ./...\n```\n\n测试覆盖：向量钟语义、缓冲释放、去重恰好一次、背压不破坏因果、跨源依赖、\n调度器 FIFO、五个验收场景、确定性复现（逐字段 DeepEqual）、请求校验错误。\n\n## 明确的边界（非目标）\n\n- 无前端、无网络服务监听；只有 CLI/库 + JSON。\n- 无真实节点、socket、集群；一切在单进程内用虚拟时间模拟。\n- 不实现真实成员管理/崩溃恢复；\"丢失\"指仿真窗口内不可达，重传由请求显式驱动。\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"ab2abce5-4e99-484f-9636-3f5d0b3e5210","session_id":"a95586de-a3d7-48b7-82d9-97f45b1b0417","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp28/b","sessionId":"a95586de-a3d7-48b7-82d9-97f45b1b0417","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp28-b","slug":"mellow-squishing-hickey"}

all broadcasts delivered to all nodes in causal order\n```\n\n### 3.2 `02-concurrent-reorder-dup.json` —— 并发广播、乱序、重复\n\nn3 **先**在 t=2 收到 n2:1，**后**在 t=20 收到 n1:1（乱序，但二者并发无依赖，\n均合法投递）；n4 收到 n2:1 的重复副本，仅投递一次：\n\n```\nstatus: ok\n  deliver t=0   node=n1 origin=n1:1 'concurrent-from-n1'\n  deliver t=0   node=n2 origin=n2:1 'concurrent-from-n2'\n  deliver t=2   node=n3 origin=n2:1\n  deliver t=3   node=n1 origin=n2:1\n  deliver t=5   node=n4 origin=n2:1\n  deliver t=20  node=n3 origin=n1:1\n  deliver t=24  node=n2 origin=n1:1\n  deliver t=24  node=n4 origin=n1:1\n  duplicates suppressed: {'n1': 1, 'n2': 1, 'n3': 2, 'n4': 3}\n  root_missing_blockers: [] / undelivered_origins: []\n```\n\n### 3.3 `03-loss-repair.json` —— 丢失前驱，重传后释放\n\nn1→n2、n1→n3 首跳全部 `drop`；t=40 由 n1 显式重传，t=42 两节点投递：\n\n```\nstatus: ok\n  deliver t=0   node=n1 origin=n1:1 'lost-then-repaired'\n  deliver t=42  node=n2 origin=n1:1 'lost-then-repaired'\n  deliver t=42  node=n3 origin=n1:1 'lost-then-repaired'\n  root_missing_blockers: [] / undelivered_origins: []\n```\n\n### 3.4 `04-backpressure-retry.json` —— 缓冲容量 1 + 背压 + 重试\n\nn2 的缓冲容量=1；n1:1 被延迟到 t=40，n1:2、n1:3 先到 → 产生 **6 次背压\n事件**；无限重试（间隔 5ms）在 t=40 前驱到达后成功，三条按序投递，\n`retry` 最终结果仅 `delivered`：\n\n```\n  ...\n  deliver t=40  node=n2 origin=n1:1 'bp-1'\n  deliver t=40  node=n2 origin=n1:2 'bp-2'\n  deliver t=40  node=n2 origin=n1:3 'bp-3'\n  backpressure events: 6\n  retry results: ['delivered']\n  undelivered_origins: []\n```\n\n配套单测 `TestBackpressureGiveUp`（`max_attempts=0` 默认放弃）验证：被拒副本\n记入 `retry_events[].result=\"given_up\"`，已缓冲/已投递部分顺序仍正确。\n\n### 3.5 `05-permanent-loss-diagnosis.json` —— 永久缺失诊断\n\n- n1:1 对 n3 的两条路径分别被延迟 500ms（超窗）和 drop → n3 永远等不到前驱；\n- n1:2 在 t=3 到达 n3，依赖 n1:1 不满足 → **滞留缓冲**；\n- n1:3 对所有接收方首跳 drop（叶子拓扑无其他修复源）→ **根缺失**。\n\n```\n  deliver t=2   node=n2 origin=n1:1\n  deliver t=3   node=n2 origin=n1:2\n  still buffered: {'n3': ['n1:2']}\n  root_missing_blockers: ['n1:3']\n  undelivered_origins: ['n1:1', 'n1:2', 'n1:3']\n  diag: PERMANENT LOSS: only the originating node holds these messages; no receiver\n        can repair them by retransmission within end_time_ms: n1:3\n  diag: NODE n3: n1:2 waits on [n1:1]\n```\n\n> 说明：`undelivered_origins` 按\"至少一个节点未投递\"统计（n1:1、n1:2 对 n3\n> 未投递）；`root_missing_blockers` 只列**除源头外无任何节点持有**的 n1:3。\n\n## 4. CLI 错误处理与确定性\n\n```\n$ echo '{\"nodes\":[\"a\"],\"end_time_ms\":10}' | ./bin/cbsim ; echo exit=$?\n{ \"status\": \"error\", \"error\": \"at least 2 nodes required\", ... }   # 各数组字段为 []\nexit=2\n\n$ echo 'not json' | ./bin/cbsim ; echo exit=$?\ncbsim: invalid request JSON: invalid character 'o' in literal null (expecting 'u')\nexit=1\n\n$ diff <(./bin/cbsim -in examples/02-...json) <(./bin/cbsim -in examples/02-...json)\n# 无输出：同 seed 两次运行逐字节相同（TestDeterminism 同时做了字段级 DeepEqual）\n```\n\n## 5. 开发过程中出现并已修复的问题（如实记录）\n\n1. **就绪条件把消息自身当依赖**：初版 `Broadcast` 把自身 `(origin,seq)` 加进\n   依赖向量，导致每条消息\"永远等待自己\"、全部滞留缓冲。改为标准规则\n   （非自身依赖 + 同源 `seq-1` 前驱）后修复，并有 `TestBufferThenRelease` 锁定。\n2. **调度器窗口边界**：初版 `Run` 用 `Time < endTime`，同虚拟时刻链式事件被\n   提前截断。改为 `Time <= endTime` + 哨兵置于 `endTime+1`，\n   `TestSchedulerChainedSameTime` 覆盖。\n3. **故障动作串不匹配**：JSON 用 `\"drop\"`/`\"duplicate\"`，switch 一度只匹配\n   内部常量 `\"dropped\"`，导致丢包故障被静默放行。已对齐并加校验\n   （`TestValidationErrors/invalid_fault_action`）。\n4. **全互联 gossip 掩盖丢包**：首跳 drop 后会被其他接收方中继自然修复，无法\n   演示\"真正丢失\"。引入有向 `topology`，并约定省略 `from` 的故障只锚定源头\n   直发副本。\n5. 若干测试预期曾按\"单一路径\"书写，未考虑中继旁路；已改为与实际多路径语义\n   一致的断言。\n\n当前 `go test ./...`、`go test -race ./...`、`go vet ./...`、`gofmt -l .`\n均无未通过项。完整的机读结果见 `examples/out/*.out.json`。\n","structuredPatch":[],"originalFile":null,"userModified":false},"sourceToolAssistantUUID":"2be02301-6216-4b60-8410-5605641c7724","session_id":"a95586de-a3d7-48b7-82d9-97f45b1b0417","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp28/b","sessionId":"a95586de-a3d7-48b7-82d9-97f45b1b0417","version":"2.1.280","gitBranch":"ab/run-20260922T151547Z/opp28-b","slug":"mellow-squishing-hickey"}

(\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"sort\"\n\n\t\"causal-broadcast/internal/vec\"\n)\n\n// Message is one broadcast copy carried between nodes.\ntype Message struct {\n\tOrigin  vec.Key   `json:\"origin\"` // (originating node, per-origin seq)\n\tSender  string    `json:\"sender\"` // node that relayed this copy\n\tFrom    string    `json:\"from\"`   // immediate previous hop (for logging)\n\tDeps    []vec.Key `json:\"deps\"`   // causal dependency vector (all keys <= V_origin)\n\tClock   vec.Clock `json:\"clock\"`  // origin's clock at broadcast time (redundant with Deps, kept for inspection)\n\tPayload string    `json:\"payload\"`\n}\n\n// Delivery records one successful application-level delivery.\ntype Delivery struct {\n\tTime    int64     `json:\"time\"`\n\tNode    string    `json:\"node\"`\n\tOrigin  vec.Key   `json:\"origin\"`\n\tPayload string    `json:\"payload\"`\n\tClock   vec.Clock `json:\"clock_after\"`\n}\n\n// Outcome classifies what a node does with an incoming copy.\ntype Outcome int\n\nconst (\n\t// Delivered means this copy (or buffered messages it unblocked) was applied.\n\tDelivered Outcome = iota\n\t// Buffered means the message is held waiting for missing dependencies.\n\tBuffered\n\t// Duplicate means this message was already delivered; the copy is dropped.\n\tDuplicate\n\t// Backpressure means dependencies are missing AND the buffer is full;\n\t// the message is rejected and NOT retained (retry may arrive later).\n\tBackpressure\n)\n\n// BackpressureEvent captures one rejected copy for diagnostics.\ntype BackpressureEvent struct {\n\tTime      int64     `json:\"time\"`\n\tNode      string    `json:\"node\"`\n\tOrigin    vec.Key   `json:\"origin\"`\n\tCapacity  int       `json:\"capacity\"`\n\tWaitingOn []vec.Key `json:\"waiting_on\"`\n}\n\n// Node is a single simulated process.\ntype Node struct {\n\tID        string\n\tclock     vec.Clock\n\tbuffer    map[vec.Key]*Message\n\tdelivered map[vec.Key]bool\n\tcap       int\n\n\t// Counters/logs\n\tdupCount     int\n\tbackpressure []BackpressureEvent\n}\n\n// New creates a node with a hold-back buffer bounded by capacity (<=0 means\n// unbounded).\nfunc New(id string, capacity int) *Node {\n\treturn &Node{\n\t\tID:        id,\n\t\tclock:     vec.Clock{},\n\t\tbuffer:    map[vec.Key]*Message{},\n\t\tdelivered: map[vec.Key]bool{},\n\t\tcap:       capacity,\n\t}\n}\n\n// Clock returns a copy of the node's delivered vector clock.\nfunc (n *Node) Clock() vec.Clock { return n.clock.Clone() }\n\n// BufferLen returns the number of messages currently {"parentUuid":"0de6b5c2-29ab-43d7-ae33-9c84fd325979","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"text":"已从零完成「因果广播缓冲」纯后端项目，并实际运行、如实记录。\n\n## 交付物\n\n**源码（Go 1.22，标准库零外部依赖，约 2k 行含测试）**\n- `internal/vec/` — 向量钟：`(源节点,序号)` 依赖键、满足判定\n- `internal/sim/` — 确定性离散事件调度器（虚拟时间 + (时间,FIFO) 小顶堆，无 goroutine/wall-clock）\n- `internal/simnet/` — 不可靠网络：丢包/重复/随机延迟乱序 + 逐条确定性故障注入\n- `internal/node/` — 因果投递：依赖未满足进 hold-back 缓冲、递归释放、去重恰好一次、有界缓冲背压\n- `internal/engine/` — 拓扑邻接表、定时广播、投递触发器（链式）、显式重传、最终缺失诊断\n- `cmd/cbsim/` — JSON 运行接口（`-in/-out` 或 stdin/stdout；退出码 0/1/2）\n\n**文档与样例**\n- `README.md`（字段表、因果规则、拓扑为何需要的说明）、`RUNLOG.md`（真实命令/输出/未通过项）\n- `examples/01–05` 五个请求样例 + `examples/out/` 机读结果\n\n## 验收场景实测结果（全部 `status:ok`）\n1. **链式+乱序+前驱补齐**：n2 投递 n1:1 后链式产生 n2:1；n3 前驱延迟到 t=30，到齐后同刻按 n1:1→n2:1 因果序释放\n2. **并发+乱序+重复**：n3 先收 n2:1(2ms) 后收 n1:1(20ms)；n4 重复副本仅投递一次\n3. **丢失前驱→重传释放**：首跳全 drop，t=40 重传、t=42 两节点补齐\n4. **背压**：容量 1 触发 6 次背压事件，无限重试在前驱到达后按序冲刷；另有放弃策略单测验证 `given_up` 且不破坏顺序\n5. **永久缺失诊断**：n3 滞留 n1:2 并报 `waits on [n1:1]`；n1:3 对所有接收方丢失，报 `root_missing_blockers:['n1:3']`\n\n## 质量门\n`go build`、`go vet`、`gofmt -l`、`go test -race ./...` 全部干净；**18 个测试全部 PASS，无未通过项**（含逐字段 DeepEqual 的确定性复现、对每份输出独立复核因果不变量）。\n\n`RUNLOG.md` 第 5 节如实记录了开发中真实出现并修复的 4 个设计/实现 bug（消息自依赖、调度窗口边界、故障动作串不匹配、全互联 gossip 掩盖丢包）。未做任何前端；未提交
